【中美建設性戰略穩定關係──邁向正確相處之道的重要一步】中美關係迎來舉世矚目的歷史性時刻。當地時間9月23日下午，國家主席習近平抵達華盛頓，對美國進行國事訪問。從北京到華盛頓，兩國元首時隔不到半年再次會晤，為中美關係這艘大船領航掌舵。當地時間9月24日上午，習近平主席同特朗普總統會談時指出，中美建設性戰略穩定關係的新定位反映了中美關係的現實，也體現了對未來的期許，是邁向兩國正確相處之道的重要一步。我們要把這一願景轉化為行動，朝著合作為主、競爭有度、分歧可控、和平可期的方向努力，走出一條兩個大國的正確相處之道。（新華社）

【Australia health system reportedly breached by OpenAI AI; UK offers help】UK cybersecurity officials offered assistance after Australia’s healthcare system was reportedly breached by an advanced OpenAI AI system. The Daily Telegraph reported officers from the UK National Cyber Security Centre are contacting Australian counterparts to assess the scope and provide support. A UK government spokesman called the incident serious, saying it underscores why risks from advanced AI are taken extremely seriously and that the UK is in close contact with Australia and ready to assist.
【日本10年期國債收益率一度升至3.115%】據日本方面訊息，在9月25日的東京債券市場上，作為長期利率指標的新發10年期國債收益率一度升至3.115%。據日本相互證券公司統計，這是自1996年8月以來的最高水平。國債收益率與價格呈反向關係，收益率升高意味著債券價格下跌。（央視新聞）
【小米汽車將參加2026天津車展】9月25日，小米汽車宣佈，全系產品將於9月30日–10月6日亮相2026天津國際車展。

【“中國天眼”十歲了 未來將從單眼升級為陣列 解析度提升200倍】今天（25日）是500米單口徑球面射電望遠鏡FAST落成十週年。執行十年，FAST持續叩問浩瀚蒼穹、取得一批原創成果。在完成三天全面檢修後，今天，“中國天眼”開啟了新一輪探索宇宙的觀測。而且就在距離FAST三四公里的山上，FAST二期試驗陣的一臺40米口徑望遠鏡迎來建設關鍵節點。FAST執行和發展中心主任兼總工程師 姜鵬：我們計劃在FAST周邊建設數十臺40米口徑望遠鏡，構建全球唯一一個“以巨型望遠鏡為中心、中型望遠鏡環繞”的綜合口徑陣列，陣列建成後，可以把FAST解析度提升200倍，靈敏度提升1倍。未來，FAST核心陣不僅能看得遠，還能看得更清。（央視）

【Israel's Starlink provocation at UNGA ignored by Iran】On Sept. 24 at the UN General Assembly general debate, Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu displayed a Starlink terminal and said he would hand it to the Iranian delegation so the Iranian people could "exercise choice and access the truth." Many delegations walked out in protest; the Iranian delegation also left and placed a photo of the late IRGC Quds Force commander Qassem Soleimani on its seat. After the session Israel's UN ambassador Danny Danon approached the Iranian delegation with a Starlink terminal, said it was "appropriate to give it" and said he "prayed for regime change" in Iran. Both gestures were ignored by the Iranian delegation.

【美國擬擴大護照檔案調取許可權，用於選民資格核查】美國國務院正推進一項舉措，向州及地方政府官員，還可能向部分非營利組織開放護照檔案，以此核驗選民的公民身份。這份方案在近期送交國會核心議員的通知檔案中披露，計劃將 “選民資格核驗” 列入國務院護照服務檔案的常規使用用途正式清單，並且把資料開放物件擴大至政府機構以外的主體。歷史上，該類資料的使用方主要限於國內外政府機構與公職人員。此次許可權擴容，將配合特朗普政府一項頗具爭議的行動：呼叫聯邦檔案，開展選舉舞弊調查，並協助各州核查選民登記名冊。此舉會讓更多機構獲取這份受美國隱私法保護的敏感資料。媒體拿到的這份國務院通知副本，並未寫明哪些非營利組織有資格獲取該資料。按照行政流程時間表，該提案要等到11月3日中期選舉之後才會生效；本次選舉中，共和黨需要守住其在國會微弱的多數席位。
摩根大通首次覆蓋獅門影業，給予“減持”評級，目標價9美元。

【South Africa plans $2.7bln upgrade to manganese export infrastructure, new port and rail repairs】South Africa plans to invest up to 44 billion rand (about $2.7 bln) to upgrade manganese export infrastructure, including building a manganese-export berth at Ngqura Port and repairing rail links, Transnet said in pre-qualification documents. Transnet intends to bring in private partners to build, fund and operate the berth under a 25-year concession; roughly 20 billion rand (about $1.2 bln) is earmarked for rail repairs to boost mine-to-port capacity. South Africa holds around 70% of proven global manganese reserves; the project is aimed at easing export bottlenecks and improving mineral transport efficiency.
【人民日報：北斗為新興支柱產業打造重要增長極】2025年，我國北斗產業總體產值突破6290億元，同比增長9.24%，國內北斗產業企事業單位超3萬家，從業人員超200萬人。歷經多年自主攻堅、迭代培育、全域賦能，北斗已經從技術探索、場景試點的產業培育階段，向著規模集聚、生態完善、賦能全域性的產業新引擎加速邁進，成長為紮根實體經濟、賦能千行百業、普惠千家萬戶的國之重器。
【翼菲科技機器人進入PCB產線，已在多家廠商批次落地】9月25日，介面新聞獲悉，翼菲科技機器人已在PCB生產環節批次落地，覆蓋收放板、清洗上下料、檢測搬運等工序。目前，其客戶包括景旺電子、生益科技、崇達技術、鵬鼎控股、世運電路等PCB廠商。

【Han Zheng meets Bulgarian President Yotova】On Sept. 24, 2026 in New York during the UN General Assembly, Chinese Vice President Han Zheng met Bulgarian President Yotova. Han said China and Bulgaria will deepen high-level exchanges and political trust, safeguard each other’s core interests, and advance pragmatic cooperation in agriculture, information and communications, and auto-parts manufacturing; China also offered to expand youth, education and cultural-tourism exchanges and strengthen multilateral coordination.

Malaysia Leading Index Steady at 0.3% in July — Malaysia's leading economic index rose 0.3% month-on-month in July 2026, unchanged from June's upwardly revised figure. The increase in the leading economic index was boosted by a further rise in real imports of other basic precious and non-ferrous metals (0.1% vs 0.9% in June), the number of housing units approved (0.04% vs 0.5%), real imports of semiconductors (0.1% vs 0.2%), a rebound in real money supply M1 (0.1% vs -0.1%), and expected sales value in manufacturing (0.1% vs -0.4%). On an annual basis, the leading index increased 1.1%, easing from an upwardly revised 1.5% in June. Meanwhile, the coincident index, a gauge of current economic conditions, edged down 0.1% month-on-month, reversing a 0.3% gain in June.

【南非擬投入27億美元改造錳礦出口基礎設施】南非《商業日報》援引國有物流企業南非運輸集團（Transnet SOC Ltd）釋出的資格預審檔案稱，南非計劃新建港口碼頭、修復鐵路線路，用於錳礦出口，專案總投資最高可達440億蘭特（摺合27億美元）。報道稱，南非運輸集團將向私營企業授予為期25年的特許經營權，由其在恩庫拉港建設並運營該碼頭。報道顯示，鐵路線路修復與維護費用約200億蘭特。南非已探明錳礦儲量約佔全球總量70%，大多集中於北開普省卡拉哈里盆地，這也是全球已知規模最大的陸上錳礦礦床。

【獨家 | 影石正佈局AI眼鏡，或採用“分體電池”設計】有接近影石創新人士透露，當前影石創新正在佈局AI眼鏡賽道，並在進行相關研發，未來或將推出自己的AI眼鏡產品。此前，影石創新獲得了一項名為“可穿戴式眼鏡”的實用新型專利授權。專利摘要顯示，該眼鏡主體佩戴於頭部，電池裝置與眼鏡主體分離、佩戴於身體其他部位，透過電連線線供電，目的是“減輕使用者頭部負重，降低長時間佩戴的壓力”。這一“分體電池”設計思路，與當前主流AI眼鏡將電池塞入鏡腿的方案明顯不同，更接近長時間佩戴拍攝的工程取向。（新浪科技）

【China says Middle East security should be led by regional states】China's deputy UN envoy Sun Lei told an informal Security Council–Arab League dialogue on the 24th that Middle East security should be led by regional states. He said the Palestinian issue remains central and urged irreversible steps to implement a two‑state solution and early Palestinian statehood. China encouraged the US and Iran to exercise restraint and to return promptly to the Islamabad memorandum of understanding, rebuilding a negotiation mechanism based on consensus reached to date. Beijing warned against further spillover to Yemen and the Red Sea, urged parties to stop actions that complicate the situation, and called for effective measures to restore normal, secure transit through the Strait of Hormuz to safeguard global trade and supply chains. It said merchant vessels' navigation rights in the Red Sea under international law should be respected.

【Hong Kong midday: HSI down 1.69%; major tech names slide】By midday trade, the Hang Seng Index (HSI) was down 1.69% and the Hang Seng Tech Index fell 2.14%. Large tech names broadly lower: Xiaomi Group (01810.HK) down >3%; Alibaba (09988.HK), Baidu (09888.HK), Meituan (03690.HK) and JD.com (09618.HK) each down >2%. Property names underperformed: Country Garden (02007.HK) -4.8%, China Vanke (02202.HK) -5.6%. Losses were concentrated in power equipment, gaming software, physical AI and new-energy vehicle makers.
【設計時速350公里 宜興高鐵9月28日開通運營】從國鐵集團獲悉，宜昌至興山高鐵（以下簡稱“宜興高鐵”）將於9月28日開通運營，宜昌北至興山站最快30分鐘可達。屆時，將形成滬渝蓉高鐵與鄭渝高鐵的聯絡通道，武漢至重慶間高鐵列車經由宜興高鐵執行後，徑路進一步最佳化，時空距離進一步壓縮，兩地最快3小時54分鐘可達。

【中國代表：中東安全事務主導權應由中東國家自主掌握】中國常駐聯合國副代表孫磊24日在安理會同阿盟“三駕馬車”高階別非正式對話會上發言，強調中東安全事務主導權應由中東國家自主掌握。孫磊說，中方支援安理會同阿盟加強合作，支援阿盟在地區安全事務上發揮更大作用，鼓勵以地區方式解決地區問題。他說，巴勒斯坦問題仍是中東問題的核心。國際社會要採取不可逆行動，落實“兩國方案”，早日實現巴勒斯坦獨立建國。中方鼓勵美國和伊朗保持理性剋制，儘快迴歸伊斯蘭堡諒解備忘錄，根據迄今達成的共識，重構談判機制。中方不希望地區緊張局勢向葉門和紅海方向進一步外溢，呼籲各方停止使局勢進一步複雜化，透過對話談判解決問題。中方敦促各方採取有效措施，確保霍爾木茲海峽儘早恢復正常安全通行，維護全球貿易和產供鏈穩定。各國商船根據國際法在紅海水域的航行權利應得到尊重。（新華社）
傑富瑞將 GoDaddy 目標價由 85 美元上調至 100 美元。
【趙剛會見歷軍一行】9月24日，陝西省長趙剛在西安會見了曙光資訊產業股份有限公司董事長曆軍一行。雙方圍繞加強在算力基礎設施建設、人工智慧產業等領域的合作進行了深入交流。

【2024年全球海平面升6毫米創紀錄】當地時間9月24日，聯合國秘書長古特雷斯在紐約舉行的海平面上升問題高階別會議上表示，全球海平面上升速度正在加快，對沿海城市、經濟發展和部分國家領土完整構成日益嚴峻的威脅。古特雷斯說，2024年全球海平面上升近6毫米，創有記錄以來年度最大升幅。他呼籲國際社會加快行動，作出回應。 此次高階別會議是第81屆聯合國大會高階別周活動之一，旨在加強國際合作和集體行動，應對海平面上升帶來的影響。

【宇樹科技王興興：機器人核心瓶頸是能否解決幾毫米的工作誤差】9月24日，第五屆全球數字貿易博覽會在杭州舉行，宇樹科技創始人王興興發表《從機械到靈智 — 具身未來進化論》主題演講。王興興判斷，具身智慧賽道未來也必將迎來專屬的“ChatGPT時刻”。當機器人可在80%的陌生場景中，透過語音具身能力完成80%的任務時，就意味著行業抵達爆發臨界點。讓機器人說指令、象徵意義執行某個具體工作，在去年已能實現。王興興認為，目前最大的問題是AI模型的輸入、輸出與真實物理世界精準匹配度不足，機器人工作會有幾毫米的誤差。“未來誰能解決這個問題，機器人的問題就完全解決了。”王興興說。（介面）

【陝西省委書記趙一德會見香港貿易發展局主席馬時亨一行】9月23日，陝西省委書記趙一德在西安會見了香港貿易發展局主席馬時亨一行。省委副書記邢善萍參加。趙一德說，陝港兩地資源稟賦與功能優勢互補性強，合作空間廣闊、潛力巨大。希望香港貿發局更好發揮橋樑紐帶作用，推動香港所長與陝西所需精準對接，在經貿、金融、科教、人文等領域拓寬合作維度、做實合作成果，同時助力更多陝企赴港上市、借港出海。歡迎廣大港企積極佈局陝西、深耕陝西，共享發展機遇、共贏美好未來。

【受AI相關產品等拉動，泰國出口創四年最大增幅】得益於全球人工智慧熱潮帶動的電子產品出口，疊加中國對泰國榴蓮、山竹需求大增，泰國出口實現四年多來最快增速。泰國商務部週五公佈資料，8月出口額同比猛增24.3%，為56個月以來最高增速，高於7月的21.6%。進口同比增長25.1%，較上月36.7%的漲幅有所回落。貿易赤字由7月的36億美元收窄至25億美元。最新資料印證了泰國商務部的判斷：今年泰國出口有望創下歷史新高。電子產品出口佔總出口近三分之一，隨著全球科技企業加大AI基礎設施投入，該品類預計將持續成為核心增長動力。

【中國第16次北冰洋考察｜北冰洋部分次表層水變暖 】記者從中國第16次北冰洋考察隊獲悉，考察隊近日在北冰洋加拿大海盆區域開展年度調查時發現，今年該區域50米至100米深度的次表層水溫度顯著高於以往同期。“雪龍2”號海洋隊隊長陳紅霞說，本航次延續了對西經169度這一歷史觀測斷面的年度觀測，透過溫鹽深儀對海洋水體進行了跨越6至7個緯度的垂直剖面觀測，觀測結果為評估流入北冰洋的太平洋水的年際變化提供了依據。中國第9次至第15次北冰洋考察採集的資料顯示，該區域50米至100米深度的次表層水溫度均在零下1.75度至零下1.15度之間，但是此次考察所獲資料則顯著升高到零下0.5度到0度之間。（新華社）
星展銀行與AVALOQ簽署諒解備忘錄，共同開發亞洲下一代財富管理科技。

【紐西蘭儲備銀行即時預測模型估算第三季度 GDP 增長 0.6%】紐西蘭儲備銀行週五於惠靈頓在官網更新紐西蘭第三季度國內生產總值即時預測。資料顯示 GDP 環比增長 0.6%。該指標已連續三週維持約 0.6%。模型預測第四季度環比增速為 0.4%。注：紐西蘭儲備銀行表示，該即時預測並非官方 GDP 預測，只是編制官方預測所使用的參考指標之一。9 月初該行預估第三季度 GDP 環比增長 0.5%，並將於 12 月釋出最新預測。

【美國佛羅里達私營鐵路Brightline因債務壓頂申請破產】佛羅里達州Brightline公司申請破產保護。多年來營收持續不及預期，這傢俬營鐵路運營商無力償還專案融資所欠下的數十億美元債務。總部位於邁阿密的Brightline在新澤西州提交《破產法》第11章破產保護申請。申請書顯示，其資產與負債規模均在10億至100億美元區間。該公司由堡壘投資集團（FortressInvestmentGroup）支援，今年大部分時間裡一直暫停支付利息，並與債權人密集磋商，試圖爭取多方債權人支援，對其總額55億美元的複雜債務進行重組。

【以色列國防軍稱打死哈馬斯軍事部門一名指揮官】9月24日，以色列國防軍在社交平臺上發帖稱，以方在一次行動中打死了巴勒斯坦伊斯蘭抵抗運動（哈馬斯）軍事部門一名指揮官。 以色列國防軍透露，該指揮官名叫馬哈茂德·阿卜杜勒·法塔赫·阿瓦德。以方指責其“參與劫持7名以色列人質”、策劃和推動“針對以色列平民和以色列國防軍士兵”的襲擊行動等。 《以色列時報》稱，以方在加沙城發動的襲擊中打死了該指揮官。 截至發稿，暫未看到哈馬斯公開對以方說法作出回應。

【馬爾地夫總統：願與中方進一步鞏固傳統友誼】馬累訊息：馬爾地夫總統穆伊茲24日在馬累表示，馬爾地夫高度重視同中國的長期友好關係，期待同中方共同應對挑戰、把握機遇，進一步鞏固傳統友誼。穆伊茲當天出席中國駐馬爾地夫大使館舉辦的慶祝中華人民共和國成立77週年招待會，並向中國政府和人民致以國慶祝賀。穆伊茲說，中國走過了一段堅韌不拔、深刻變革的非凡歷程，憑藉堅定意志和遠見卓識為世界作出重要貢獻，在經濟發展、科技、基礎設施建設和民生福祉等領域取得的成就廣受認可。(新華社)

Thailand Export Growth Hits 7-Month High — Thailand’s exports surged 24.3% yoy to USD 34.6 billion in August 2026, up from 21.6% in July, marking the fastest increase since January but slightly below the 24.9% forecast. Export growth was mainly driven by a rise in sales of industrial products, which grew 27.1%, marking the 29th consecutive month of growth, mainly boosted by computers and related equipment (42.1%), telephones and components (151.2%), and circuit boards (19.2%). Meanwhile, shipments of agricultural products rose 4.2%, marking the second straight month of expansion. Shipments to the US, Thailand’s largest export market, soared 48.7% year-on-year, while those to China and Japan increased 15.5% and 19.6%, respectively. For the January-August period, exports climbed 18.9% from the same period in 2025, reaching USD 266.2 billion. In July, the Commerce Ministry maintained its forecast for export growth of 8% this year, supported by easing global tensions and strong tech demand.

Thailand Trade Gap Below Forecasts — Thailand's trade deficit widened to USD 2.48 billion in August 2026, up from USD 1.96 billion a year earlier, marking an eleventh straight monthly shortfall but remaining smaller than market forecasts of USD 3.9 billion, as imports rose more than exports. Imports surged 25.1% yoy, slowing sharply from a 36.7% jump in July and below forecasts of 33%, supported by ongoing government stimulus measures aimed at boosting consumption and investment. Meanwhile, exports rose 24.3% yoy, accelerating from a 21.6% increase in July but slightly below estimates of 24.9%. Export growth was mainly boosted by an increase in sales of industrial products, which rose 27.1%. Shipments to the US, Thailand’s largest export market, soared 48.7% year-on-year, while those to China and Japan rose 15.5% and 19.6%, respectively. For the first eight months of the year, the country recorded a USD 37.8 billion deficit, as exports rose much less (18.9%) than imports (36.1%).
Thailand's Ministry of Commerce expects exports to continue growing through year-end.

【RBA rate-hike pressure rises as growth resilience strengthens; stronger GDP may prompt more cautious policy stance】Markets price a possible RBA rate increase next week as the bank watches domestic and global inflation risks while weighing stronger domestic growth momentum. Westpac economist Pat Bustamante forecasts Australia Q3 GDP YoY at 2.3% (Q2: 2.1%), saying the economy has shown greater resilience than expected. Bustamante warns the RBA is unlikely to welcome stronger growth—policy makers are aiming to nudge activity below trend to secure disinflation—and sustained momentum would increase uncertainty around disinflation and complicate the RBA’s policy path.

Thailand Import Growth Below Estimates — Thailand’s imports rose 25.1% year-on-year to USD 37.10 billion in August 2026, slowing from a 36.7% surge in the previous month and marking the weakest growth since December 2025. The latest result also fell short of market expectations for a 33% increase, suggesting softer domestic demand and investment activity. Still, purchases increased across all major categories: fuel (42.8%), capital goods (33.9%), other goods (27.4%), raw materials and intermediate goods (21.3%), transport equipment (13.6%), and consumer goods (1.3%). By commodity, imports rose for most components, including machinery and components (61.4%), crude oil (58.2%), computers (57.2%), other metal ores and scrap (41.2%), plants (24.6%), jewelry and gold (22.3%), chemicals (19.4%), and circuit boards (17.8%). In contrast, imports fell for iron and steel (-2.2%) and electrical machinery (-1.1%). In the first eight months of 2026, total arrivals surged 36.1% from the same period in 2025 to USD 303.9 billion.

Copper Pressured by Hawkish Fed Outlook — Copper futures fell to around $6.66 per pound on Friday, touching one-week lows as a stronger US dollar and rising Treasury yields weighed on prices amid expectations that the Federal Reserve will continue raising interest rates to combat inflation. Higher borrowing costs could eventually slow global economic growth, weighing on demand for industrial metals. Still, copper remains supported by persistent supply risks, with union workers at Escondida, the world’s largest copper mine in Chile, calling for a strike after rejecting a wage offer. Metals trader Sprott Asset Management also said global mined copper output could decline this year for the first time since 2017, while disruptions at major mines in Indonesia and the Democratic Republic of Congo have reduced expected annual production by an estimated 600,000 tons. On the demand side, consumption remains strong across power grids, AI data centers and the defense sector.

Palm Oil Sinks, Steep Weekly Loss Looms — Malaysian palm oil futures slipped around 2% to below MYR 4,700 per tonne, extending last week’s decline to a six-week low. A stronger ringgit and weaker soybean oil on the Chicago Board of Trade weighed on sentiment. Meanwhile, a pullback in crude oil after recent gains added pressure amid expectations that the Strait of Hormuz could reopen and U.S. curbs on Iranian exports could ease. Rising Malaysian inventories and sluggish demand from India, the world’s largest vegetable-oil buyer, further dampened the market, though industry officials noted El Niño’s impact has yet to materialise. Still, losses were partly cushioned by India’s move to cut import duties on crude and refined vegetable oils ahead of the September–November festive season to curb food inflation. On the supply side, Indonesia may face a shorter-than-usual wet season from November, potentially affecting crop conditions. For the week, futures are down about 4.6%, erasing the prior week’s gains in a steep reversal.

【Japanese cabinet minister says Abenomics-era reflation has ended】Minoru Kiuchi, minister for economic growth strategy, said on Friday Japan no longer needs large-scale monetary easing and flexible fiscal spending. He added Japan is no longer in an era of monetary easing and has entered a phase of gradually rising prices and rising interest rates.

【日本經濟安保擔當大臣城內實：日本已告別再通脹政策階段】日本經濟安保擔當大臣城內實表示，日本已告別透過激進貨幣寬鬆和靈活財政支出來推動再通脹的政策階段。城內實以其再通脹政策立場著稱。城內實週五在新聞釋出會上表示，以大舉放寬貨幣政策和靈活運用財政政策為特徵的“安倍經濟學式”再通脹政策時代已經結束，日本已進入物價逐步上漲、利率走高的階段。

【Pezeshkian says Iran willing to seek US deal, will forgo 60% enriched uranium】President Pezeshkian said Iran has signed and approved an understanding framework and remains willing to pursue an agreement with the US. He said Iran will continue to abide by its NPT commitments and would relinquish 60% enriched uranium within international law and the NPT framework. Pezeshkian said the Strait of Hormuz has remained open and accused others of attacking Iran without legal justification. 【交個朋友直播間就萬向輪溜溜凳質量問題致歉：啟動先行賠付，全量退款】9月25日，針對消費者反映的交個朋友直播間所售萬向輪溜溜凳存在木板發黴、填充物不合格等問題，交個朋友直播間發文表示確有其事，“該產品在“交個朋友智慧家居爆品榜”等六個直播間銷售過，我們在此向購買過該產品的消費者鄭重道歉”。交個朋友直播間表示，事發後，交個朋友旗下所有直播間第一時間全面下架該產品，終止與該品牌的合作，並在第一時間啟動退賠處理流程。接下來，其對該商家依法追究全部責任的同時，為保證相關的消費者的問題能及時得到解決，會即刻啟動先行賠付的工作，並承諾所有購買過該產品的消費者，均做退款不退貨處理。目前正透過平臺協助統一辦理，消費者無需單獨申請。

US Natgas Prices Drop on Profit-Taking — US natural gas prices fell to $3.16 per MMBtu on Friday as traders took profits after prices surged to a 13-week high in the previous session amid supply disruptions in West Virginia. TC Energy’s Columbia Gas Transmission pipeline in Appalachia declared force majeure due to an unexpected mechanical issue, prompting the biggest single-day gain in gas prices since January. The market also remains supported by rising LNG feedgas demand, with flows to the nine major export plants averaging 17.8 bcfd in September, up from 17.2 bcfd in August, even with the 0.8-bcfd Cove Point facility offline for planned maintenance. Meanwhile, EIA data showed inventories rose by 53 Bcf for the week ended September 18, narrowing the storage surplus over the 5-year average to 95 Bcf from 118 Bcf a week ago, as hot weather boosted cooling demand. While September production remains near record levels at an average 112.8 bcfd, daily output has been falling mainly due to declines in Louisiana and West Virginia.

【中國足協黨委書記：堅決杜絕國家隊建設急功近利，防範職業足球領域重蹈金元足球覆轍】9月24日，中國足協召開黨建工作專題會議。會議深入學習貫徹習近平黨建思想，圍繞巡視整改工作，部署落實舉措，以巡視整改切實推進黨建工作提質增效。體育總局副局長、中國足協黨委書記張家勝主持會議並講話。總局直屬機關黨委分管日常工作的副書記、黨組巡視辦主任張銳鏵，中國足協在京班子成員、各黨支部書記、各部門負責人參加會議。張家勝指出，要把牢政治方向，堅持以足協高質量黨建引領足球事業高質量發展，堅守中國足協履職盡責的正確方向，堅決杜絕國家隊建設急功近利、走捷徑的老路，防範職業足球領域重蹈金元足球覆轍，預防和糾正社會足球偏離草根性質的傾向。（中國體育報）

【Goldman: AI stocks still attractive; $800bn cloud capex to support Asian hardware chain】Timothy Moe, head of Asia-Pacific equity strategy at Goldman Sachs, says AI-related stocks remain attractive despite rising government bond yields and that the firm is in the "longer-for-longer" camp on rates. He cites ultra-scale cloud providers' planned capex of about $800bn this year, rising to roughly $1.2trn by 2027, as a key demand signal for the Asian AI hardware supply chain. Asian equities trade at about 10x PE, near the low end of their historical range, which Moe says adds valuation support while corporate earnings growth should help buffer a high-rate environment. He expects market volatility to persist into the U.S. midterms, with high energy prices and geopolitical risks adding downside pressure, but sees a potential year-end rally driven by earnings and valuation recovery once that phase passes.

【招商證券國際：維持吉利汽車目標價34.2港元及“增持”評級】招商證券國際釋出研報稱，維持吉利汽車(00175)目標價34.2港元及“增持”評級。該行表示，看好智充技術向主流車型滲透，以及補能網路擴張對吉利純電車型競爭力的提升。該行指出，吉利智充技術釋出，高倍率快充與AI管理協同升級，直擊溫控、養護、自動化三大補能痛點。9月23日，吉利釋出吉利智充，依託與階躍星辰共同開發的星睿PowerMind能源大腦，推出AI極速充、AI智慧充與AI自動充。其中，AI極速充提升尖峰功率、壓低溫升；AI智慧充兼顧速度與電池壽命；AI自動充減少人工插槍。

【交銀國際：上調2027-2028年全球AI加速器出貨量預測 建議關注中芯國際等】交銀國際釋出研報稱，據主要加速器公司對2027年及之後的出貨量指引，該行認為市場對2027年後加速器出貨或有更好的能見度，全球加速器市場增速較此前預測更為樂觀，分別上調2027年及2028年全年加速器出貨量預測至3451萬片及5234萬片。標的方面，該行建議CPU方向關注AMD，儲存器方向關注SK海力士，同時認為大市值加速器和晶圓代工公司估值更具吸引力，建議關注博通、英偉達、臺積電和中芯國際。

Wheat Slides Over 2% to One-Month Low — Wheat slid more than 2% to below $7 per bushel, hitting its lowest level since August 25, as traders awaited significant breakthroughs in agricultural trade talks between the US and China amid their summit in Washington. Earlier Thursday, US President Donald Trump said the two leaders had made “tremendous strides” toward improving US access to the Chinese market through the newly created Board of Trade. However, the lack of specific details disappointed some market participants. Traders expect Chinese purchases of US crops, including wheat, to increase if tariffs are removed, as both countries have discussed reducing tariffs on certain goods, including US agricultural and energy products. Meanwhile, investors are also focused on renewed diplomatic talks between Ukraine and Russia, with hopes of restoring grain exports through the Black Sea.

【China urges better development environment for landlocked developing countries】China's deputy UN permanent representative Sun Lei told a meeting of foreign ministers of landlocked developing countries on the 24th that these countries still face major structural constraints and that implementing the 2024–2034 Ten‑Year Avaza Programme of Action is urgent. China said it supports the UN's coordinating role, called on the international community to increase practical assistance, and urged turning the programme's commitments into concrete measures.

Corn Retreats from 3-Year Highs — Corn futures fell to below $5.2 per bushel, pulling back from three-year highs as weak US export demand pressured the market. Corn export sales for the week ended September 17 came in at just 838,000 metric tons, at the lower end of analyst expectations, while total commitments for the 2026/27 marketing year were 29% below a year earlier. Wet conditions and rainfall across parts of the Midwest also continued to limit harvest activity, supporting crop basis levels, with cooler-than-average temperatures and above-normal rainfall expected across the Corn Belt over the next two weeks. Elsewhere, the latest US-China summit offered little progress on agricultural trade, while elevated Treasury yields and a stronger dollar weighed on grain markets by making US crops more expensive for overseas buyers. Meanwhile, USDA’s September outlook cut its 2026/27 US corn yield estimate to 178.5 bushels per acre and production to 15.8 billion bushels, pointing to a tighter supply outlook.

【中國代表呼籲最佳化內陸發展中國家發展環境】中國常駐聯合國副代表孫磊24日在聯合國內陸發展中國家外長會上發言，呼籲最佳化內陸發展中國家發展環境。孫磊說，當前，內陸發展中國家仍面臨諸多結構性制約，實現可持續發展任重道遠，落實《內陸發展中國家2024－2034年十年阿瓦扎行動綱領》更顯緊迫。中方支援聯合國發揮重要協調作用，引領國際社會加大對內陸發展中國家支援，將行動綱領各項承諾轉化為務實舉措。他說，國際社會應維護多邊貿易體制，提高貿易自由化便利化水平，為內陸發展中國家融入經濟全球化創造有利條件。各方應支援內陸發展中國家推進經濟結構轉型，提升自主發展能力。過境國與內陸發展中國家應加強傳統和數字基礎設施互聯互通，降低糧食、能源等重要物資跨境流通成本，深化區域經濟一體化，推動從“陸鎖”邁向“陸聯”。發達國家應履行官方發展援助承諾，幫助內陸發展中國家解決融資困難。全球南方應加強團結互助，發揮南南合作在能力建設和知識分享領域獨特優勢。聯合國發展系統、國際金融機構和私營部門等利益攸關方應加強協作，形成更大合力。（央視新聞）

【泰國交易所與紐約證券交易所簽署雙重上市協議】泰國證券交易所主席阿薩德吉·空西里於週五釋出宣告稱，泰國證券交易所已與紐約證券交易所簽署諒解備忘錄，搭建雙重上市合作框架。該協議涵蓋產品與指數開發、ETF交叉上市、市場資料、ESG產品以及資訊共享。本次合作旨在幫助泰國上市企業更好觸達全球投資者與資本，同時拓寬國際投資者投資泰國資產的渠道。合作也將為赴泰投資的境外企業提供更多融資選擇，助力泰國政府的招商引資工作。

Yen Remains on Intervention Watch — The Japanese yen traded around 158.5 per dollar on Friday, staying near two-week lows and close to the key 160 level that could test Tokyo’s tolerance for further yen weakness. The currency also remained under pressure from a stronger dollar and surging Treasury yields as expectations grew that the Federal Reserve will tighten policy further to curb inflation. Moreover, the yen weakened as the Bank of Japan’s rate hike last week was viewed as insufficiently hawkish, with two officials dissenting from the decision. Meanwhile, former board member Makoto Sakurai said the central bank is expected to raise interest rates roughly once every three months, potentially lifting them to 2% by around June next year as it seeks to tackle mounting inflationary pressures.
【央行三季度例會內容釋出 這個提法首次出現】與二季度例會相比，本次例會在表述上有幾處調整：將“加大逆週期和跨週期調節力度”改為“加大逆週期調節力度”；新增“綜合運用並適時調整貨幣政策工具”的提法，並強調要“推動貨幣政策操作框架改革完善”；同時，首次將“六張網”建設列為重點支援領域，並提出匯率市場要“防範市場‘羊群效應’和非理性預期的自我強化”。

【梅賽德斯-邁巴赫S級轎車改款上市，搭載高階智慧輔助駕駛系統】9月25日，梅賽德斯-賓士宣佈，改款邁巴赫S級轎車正式上市，售價139.8萬元起。新車車長5485毫米，軸距3396毫米，首次搭載賓士自研MB.OS架構及最新智慧人機互動系統；由中國團隊主導研發的高階後排娛樂系統，應用端側多模態VLM大模型。新車搭載由梅賽德斯-賓士與Momenta共同研發的城區及高速領航輔助駕駛系統，標配後輪主動轉向系統提供±10°轉向角。此外，車頭進氣格柵尺寸較前代增大20%，引擎蓋上的三叉星徽立標、格柵輪廓與格柵框架中的“MAYBACH”字樣均首次實現發光效果。

【Trump raises concern over yen weakness with Japan's TAKAICHI; KATAYAMA says Tokyo will keep FX talks with US Treasury】President Trump told Prime Minister TAKAICHI in a New York meeting earlier this week that he was concerned about yen depreciation, KATAYAMA said. TAKAICHI replied that an undervalued yen is a matter for attention. KATAYAMA said she will continue close coordination with US Treasury Secretary BESSENT on a range of issues including foreign exchange. Remarks came as the yen returned to trade near 160 per dollar after a five-day holiday, having weakened last week despite rate hikes from the Federal Reserve and the Bank of Japan.

【中期選舉臨近，特朗普赴俄克拉荷馬、阿拉巴馬州造勢】民調對共和黨亮起預警訊號，特朗普將在俄克拉荷馬州與阿拉巴馬州舉辦造勢集會，在傳統共和黨票倉為本黨候選人助選。 共和黨公告顯示，首場集會將在俄克拉荷馬州杜蘭特舉辦，另一場在阿拉巴馬州莫比爾舉辦。 特朗普此行意在為多個競選席位的候選人提供支援，全面提振共和黨選民投票率；集會的媒體曝光還將輻射至得克薩斯州與佛羅里達狹長地帶周邊媒體市場。

Indonesian Shares Rise Yet Face Third Weekly Decline — Indonesian equities added 25 points, or 0.4%, to 6,325 in Friday’s morning session, clawing back ground after a sharp drop the day before as tech, cyclicals, and energy led gains. Sentiment steadied after U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent confirmed Washington and Beijing agreed to extend their trade truce through January 10, 2027. President Trump is hosting a state dinner for Chinese leader Xi Jinping, who made his first Washington visit in over a decade, with both leaders underscoring AI as a key discussion point. Early movers included Sumber Alfaria Trijaya (2.3%), Indo Tambangraya Megah (2.0%), and Surya Citra Media (1.7%). However, local markets are on track for a third straight weekly decline, down nearly 2% so far, pressured by concerns over elevated oil prices and their fiscal impact. Caution also grew ahead of next week’s August trade data and September inflation. Annual inflation accelerated to 3.19% in August, driven by steeper food costs linked to El Niño effects.
【盛寶銀行：片山皋月口頭喊話難以改變日元基本面】盛寶市場首席投資策略師查魯·查納納認為，日本財務大臣片山皋月近期有關日元的表態“大體上只是又一輪口頭干預”。“除非後續出臺實質政策協調、實施干預，或是日本央行釋放更明確的緊縮路徑，否則我認為這不會從根本上改變日元的基本面格局。”

Yuan Eases as Traders Weigh Trump-Xi Meeting — The offshore yuan eased to around 6.71 per dollar on Friday and was heading for weekly losses as traders weighed developments from the Trump-Xi summit in Washington. Artificial intelligence was a central topic during Thursday’s White House meeting, with both leaders discussing how to manage competition in the rapidly evolving sector. Ahead of the talks, Trump reiterated his opposition to stricter AI guardrails, while Xi said both countries have the “capability and responsibility” to ensure the technology remains under human control. Separately, Xi urged the US to explicitly oppose Taiwan independence, marking his first public appeal for Trump to reconsider Washington’s longstanding stance on the self-governed island. The White House has yet to release an official readout of the meeting, leaving Trump's response unclear. Externally, the yuan remained under pressure from a firmer US dollar as markets priced in around a 67% chance of a Federal Reserve rate hike in October.

Japanese Yields Track Treasury Yields Higher — Japan’s 10-year government bond yield climbed to around 3.1% on Friday, reaching its highest levels since 1996 and following the rise in US Treasury yields as expectations grew that the Federal Reserve will tighten policy further to contain inflation. Bond markets continued to grapple with elevated oil prices that are fueling inflationary pressures further, though reports that the US and Iran are considering a phased deal provided some relief. The latest US Treasury bond buyback operation also came in below expectations, with just $4.078 billion of 20- and 30-year bonds purchased against $10.4678 billion offered. Domestically, former Bank of Japan board member Makoto Sakurai said the central bank is expected to raise interest rates roughly once every three months, potentially lifting them to 2% by around June next year as it seeks to address mounting inflationary pressures.

【Oxford Economics: US business‑cycle indicator in recession zone; AI investment and consumer resilience offer support】Oxford Economics says its US business‑cycle indicator has fallen into the recession zone, driven by higher energy prices that have squeezed household real incomes and slower immigration that is weakening the employment growth trend. The firm cautions the indicator may not definitively signal a recession, citing continued strong productivity growth and a wealth effect that is sustaining consumer spending; households have not shown the consumption downgrading typical ahead of or during recessions. Oxford adds that AI infrastructure spending, elevated corporate profit margins and recent tax cuts are still underpinning business investment, while tariffs and policy uncertainty remain downside risks.

Gasoline Prices Retreat — US gasoline futures fell to around $3.48 per gallon, retreating from a four-month high, as markets weighed uncertainty over potential US diesel export restrictions alongside diplomatic developments in the Middle East. While Energy Secretary Chris Wright favors voluntary curbs on diesel exports, President Trump has previously backed restrictions, leaving the policy outlook unclear. Such restrictions could prompt US refiners to cut crude runs by about 12%, according to S&P Global Energy CERA, reducing gasoline production. Meanwhile, diplomatic hopes between the US and Iran eased some supply concerns, as negotiators reportedly explored a phased path to end the war, including reopening the Strait of Hormuz and lifting Washington’s economic blockade of Iran. However, continued attacks in the Middle East tempered hopes for broader de-escalation. Separately, US gasoline inventories unexpectedly declined by 1.7 million barrels in the week ending September 18th, according to the EIA.

Hong Kong Stocks Extend Losing Streak — The Hang Seng Index slipped 1.7%, or 419 points, to 24,333 on Friday, extending losses for third consecutive sessions as surging global bond yields surged and concerns over inflation and interest rates weighed on risk appetite. The decline came after US Treasury yields climbed sharply on Thursday, with the 10-year yield rising to around 5.20%, its highest level since 2007, while the 30-year yield reached its highest level since 2004, reinforcing expectations that the Federal Reserve could keep rates higher for longer. Brent crude remained above $103 a barrel after a Houthi missile attack on Saudi Arabia revived concerns about potential supply disruptions. Technology and finance stocks led the decline, with Tencent (-1.1%), AIA (-2.2%), Xiaomi (-3.4%), HKEX (-1.4%), and Meituan (-2.5%) among the notable losers. Investors also awaited China’s PMI data and continued to assess the Trump-Xi Jinping summit for signals on trade and economic policy.

European Gas Falls on Hormuz Deal Hopes — European natural gas prices fell to €74.4 per megawatt-hour on Friday, giving back some of the previous session’s gains amid reports of US-Iran discussions over a phased agreement to reopen the Strait of Hormuz and end the US blockade. The strait remains a major sticking point in efforts to resolve the nearly seven-month conflict, with neither side willing to relinquish control of the key waterway. LNG flows from the Persian Gulf remain severely disrupted, intensifying competition between Europe and Asia for limited global supplies as the region races to rebuild inventories ahead of the winter heating season. European gas storage is currently just over 70% full, below both the seasonal norm and the region’s target, leaving the market vulnerable to further supply disruptions. Maintenance in Norway is also curbing pipeline supplies to Europe, tightening the market further. European gas prices have declined 0.6% over the week.

Soybeans Trade Sideways — Soybean futures traded around $13 per bushel, moving sideways near their highest since December 2023 as traders awaited details from an anticipated US-China summit and signs of renewed Chinese demand for US crops. Markets are looking for China to announce specific purchases of US agricultural products or remove its 10% tariff on US soybeans, while Washington and Beijing agreed to extend a pause in their trade war until January 10. The White House said in May that Beijing had committed to buying at least $17 billion of US agricultural products in 2026, 2027 and 2028, though traders cited limited evidence of follow-through. Meanwhile, a stronger dollar weighed on grain markets, making US agricultural goods more expensive for importers, while renewed diplomatic efforts in the Ukraine war raised hopes for improved Black Sea export flows. Focus now turns to USDA quarterly data due next week, expected to show September 1 soybean stocks at 324 million bushels, only slightly below a year ago.

Dollar Set for Second Weekly Gain — The dollar index held above 101 on Friday after rising for four straight sessions, trading at its strongest levels in nearly two months and on track to advance for the second consecutive week. The greenback strengthened as elevated oil prices and robust US economic data stoked inflation concerns, reinforcing expectations that the Fed may tighten policy further. Markets are currently pricing in roughly a 67% probability of a Fed rate hike in October, following last week's increase. New York Fed's John Williams said the central bank still has a lot of work to do to bring inflation under control, while Philadelphia Fed's Anna Paulson said some modest additional policy tightening could be warranted. On the data front, US weekly initial jobless claims unexpectedly fell by 1,000 to a two-month low of 197,000, pointing to continued labor-market resilience. Investors now await consumer sentiment and durable goods data on Friday for further clues about the economy.

Heating Oil Falls for Third Session — US heating oil futures fell below $4.70 per gallon, declining for a third consecutive session to a two-week low, as uncertainty over US diesel export restrictions persisted. The White House denied reports of a planned 90-day ban, while Energy Secretary Chris Wright said the administration was instead seeking voluntary curbs from major refiners. Still, President Trump earlier said he supported restricting diesel exports, leaving the administration’s approach unclear. Meanwhile, diplomatic hopes between the US and Iran eased some supply concerns, as negotiators reportedly explored a phased path to end the war, including reopening the Strait of Hormuz and lifting Washington’s economic blockade of Iran. However, continued strikes in the Middle East tempered hopes for broader de-escalation. EIA data showed US distillate inventories fell by 400,000 barrels in the week ended September 18, keeping inventories about 12% below the five-year average.

Treasury Yields Hold at 2-Decade Highs — The yield on the US 10-Year Treasury note held just below 5.2% on Friday, remaining near its highest level since 2007, while the 30-year yield stood around 5.48%, its highest since 2004. Borrowing costs have climbed as elevated oil prices and resilient US economic data fueled inflation concerns, strengthening expectations that the Federal Reserve may tighten policy further. Markets are currently pricing in roughly a 67% probability of a Fed rate hike in October, following the first increase in three years last week. Meanwhile, the US Treasury Department on Thursday repurchased $4.078 billion of 20- and 30-year bonds as part of its ongoing buyback program. The amount fell short of the $10.4678 billion in bonds offered during the operations and was also below the $6 billion in debt the Treasury had said it planned to purchase. Investors now await the University of Michigan consumer sentiment report and durable goods data on Friday for further clues on the strength of the US economy.

New Zealand 10Y Yield Climbs to Nearly 3-Year High — New Zealand’s 10-year government bond yield surged to an intraday high of 5.11% in late September, its highest level since November 2023, tracking a global bond selloff as elevated oil prices stoked inflation concerns. The intensifying selloff pushed US Treasury yields to multi-year highs, as markets raised expectations for a higher-for-longer path from the Federal Reserve. The rise in global yields added to upward pressure on New Zealand’s long-term borrowing costs, alongside rising expectations for further tightening by the Reserve Bank of New Zealand. Markets are now pricing in about a 75% chance of a third hike in October, up sharply from earlier this month. This follows Governor Anna Breman’s warning that sustained oil price increases could push near-term inflation above the central bank’s latest forecast. However, her emphasis on an uneven economic recovery highlighted the challenge of addressing inflation risks while supporting still-fragile domestic growth.

【向量網路分析儀概念股受關注 多家公司回複相關問題】向量網路分析儀概念股連續大漲，收到關注。據證券時報記者梳理，多家公司此前在互動平臺回覆時涉及相關問題。①優利德：公司2026年上半年設立了天津研發中心，與成都研發中心協同開展射頻測試儀器的技術研發，67GHz向量網路分析儀目前處於研發階段。研發進展、產品落地及市場推廣均存在較大不確定性，專案短期內不會對公司業績產生重大影響。請投資者理性看待在研專案，注意投資風險。公司已推出並銷售向量網路分析儀（VNA）產品，目前產品線主要包括VNA4000系列和VNA3000系列，主要面向無線通訊、廣播電視、汽車電子、半導體、醫療器件等領域射頻器件及元件的研發與生產測試，提供效能測試方案。②電科思儀：公司研發生產的太赫茲向量網路分析儀、訊號發生器、頻譜分析儀等系列化測試儀器，成果已應用於半導體測試、航空航天、通訊等領域。相關業務對公司經營業績的影響及具體情況請以公司公告為準，敬請投資者注意投資風險。③鼎陽科技：公司主營業務為數字示波器、向量網路分析儀、波形和訊號發生器、頻譜分析儀、源表/可程式設計直流電源/源載模擬器、數字萬用表、模組化儀器和電子負載等通用電子測試測量儀器的研發、生產和銷售。公司是全球極少數具有數字示波器、訊號發生器、頻譜分析儀和向量網路分析儀四大通用電子測試測量儀器主力產品研發、生產和銷售能力的通用電子測試測量儀器廠家。

【澳新銀行：受油價飆升影響 紐西蘭年底通脹率將達到4%】根據每週報告，澳新銀行已與其他本地銀行一樣，修改了其對紐西蘭近期通脹的預測，以反映近期油價上漲和其他價格壓力。預計第三季度通脹率將放緩至3.7%，此前為3.9%。但現在預計到2026年第四季度通脹率將加速至4%，此前預測為3.5%。預計到2027年第二季度將下降至2.5%，此前預測為1.7%。年底展望假設燃料價格壓力將持續存在，並蔓延至燃料密集型非貿易行業。此後，非貿易品價格通縮速度可能比之前預期的要慢，而行政價格通脹仍將維持在較高水平。

Japanese Shares Gain Despite Bond Rout — The Nikkei 225 Index climbed 0.6% to around 65,900 on Friday, extending gains to a fifth consecutive session even as global bond yields continued to rally on rising inflationary risks and mounting fiscal concerns. On Thursday, the 10- and 30-year US Treasury yields rose to their highest levels since 2007 and 2004, respectively, while Japan’s 10-year yield climbed to its highest level since 1996. Meanwhile, oil prices eased on reports that the US and Iran were considering a phased agreement that could reopen the Strait of Hormuz and lift a US blockade on Iranian ports, helping relieve some pressure on equities. Investors also continued to monitor US-China negotiations that could pave the way for new trade agreements. Technology and banking stocks led the gains, with Kioxia Holdings rising 1.8%, Advantest gaining 1.3%, Ibiden Co advancing 2.7%, Mitsubishi UFJ up 2%, and Sumitomo Mitsui climbing 2.5%.

【上海航交所：三大船型運價漲跌互現 遠東租金指數小幅上漲】據上海航交所，本週，國際幹散貨運輸市場三大船型市場運價漲跌互現，遠東干散貨租金指數小幅上漲。分船型來看，海岬型船市場運價小幅上漲，本週太平洋市場貨盤尚可，FFA遠期合約先漲後跌，運價止跌企穩；遠端礦航線需求穩定向好，運力供給偏緊，運價穩中有漲。巴拿馬型船市場，煤炭貨盤減少，糧食運輸需求平穩執行，市場成交氛圍轉弱，日租金小幅波動。超靈便型船市場，國內出口鋼材、菲律賓鎳礦貨盤較好，印尼至印度方向煤炭貨盤保持良好出貨態勢，日租金繼續上漲。9月23日，上海航運交易所釋出的遠東干散貨租金指數為2566.46點，較上期（9月17日，下同）上漲1.4%。

Australian Equities Slip Further, Weekly Trend Still Negative — Australian shares fell 47 points or 0.5% to 8,655 in Friday morning trade, extending losses as U.S. futures weakened after Wall Street’s choppy session overnight, pressured by rising Treasury yields and volatile oil prices. Local sentiment stayed cautious ahead of next week’s policy decision, with persistent inflation fueling expectations of another rate hike after three moves earlier this year. August labor data painted a mixed picture: the jobless rate climbed to a near five-year high of 4.6%, but employment rose more than forecast. Sectoral weakness was broad, led by tech, non-energy minerals, logistics, and industrials, with notable laggards including Xero Ltd. (-2.9%), Greatland Resources (-2.5%), REA Group (-2.2%), and Aristocrat Leisure (-2.1%). In contrast, the four major banks edged higher, up between 0.2% and 0.4%. For the week, the market is set for a fourth straight decline, down about 0.9% so far. Markets now eye U.S. President Trump–Xi Jinping summit for policy direction.

【MOFCOM: China service outsourcing steady in first eight months】China's enterprises signed service outsourcing contracts worth 1.285 trillion yuan in the first eight months of the year, MOFCOM data showed. Silver Set for Weekly Drop — Silver held below $64 an ounce on Friday and was on track to decline around 4% for the week, pressured by a stronger dollar and surging Treasury yields as expectations grew that the Federal Reserve may need to raise interest rates further to curb inflation. On Thursday, the 10- and 30-year US Treasury yields rose to their highest levels since 2007 and 2004, respectively, while the dollar climbed to a near two-month high. The moves came as stronger-than-expected US economic data and elevated oil prices fueled concerns over persistent inflation and higher interest rates. Markets are currently pricing in roughly a 67% probability of a Fed rate hike in October, following the first increase in three years last week. Meanwhile, oil prices retreated on reports that the US and Iran were considering a phased agreement that could reopen the Strait of Hormuz and lift a US blockade on Iranian ports.

【9只光伏裝置股上半年淨利潤增長】據證券時報·資料寶統計，A股光伏裝置板塊上市公司共有73家。從業績來看，在行業整體承壓背景下，9股上半年實現歸母淨利潤同比增長，主要為光伏輔材細分領域個股，1股扭虧為盈，11股同比減虧。同享科技、聯泓新科、貝特利上半年歸母淨利潤同比增幅超過100%，均屬於光伏輔材細分領域。同享科技半年報顯示，實現歸母淨利潤0.48億元，同比增長568.86%。公司表示，上半年原材料銅市場價格持續上行，公司依託下游價格傳導機制相應上調產品銷售價格，產品銷售均價有所提升，產品均價上漲帶來的收益覆蓋了出貨量減少產生的影響。

【A股股票回購一覽：10家公司披露回購進展】Wind資料顯示，9月25日，10家公司共釋出10個股票回購相關進展。其中，4家公司首次披露股票回購預案，2家公司披露股票回購實施進展，4家公司回購方案已實施完畢。

【油價下跌，美伊據稱磋商分階段協議】有訊息稱美伊談判代表正在商討一項分階段協議，協議內容包括伊朗重開霍爾木茲海峽，油價隨之走低。國際基準布倫特原油回落至每桶 106 美元附近，此前兩個交易日漲幅超 7%；美國西德克薩斯中質原油（WTI）跌破 94 美元。據知情人士透露，兩國近數月未能達成同類協議，正於聯合國大會期間爭取談判取得突破。美伊衝突進入第七個月尾聲，原油本週再度劇烈波動。戰爭前景訊號好壞交織、中東原油流通有望恢復，疊加市場猜測美國或將禁止柴油出口，多重因素擾動油價。年內布倫特原油漲幅仍超 70%，加劇通脹壓力。Karobaar Capital LP 首席投資官哈里斯・庫爾希德表示：“若無重大變故，布倫特油價大機率維持在 100 至 110 美元區間。一份可信的分階段協議可能令油價迅速回落至 100 美元下方；而出口或物流鏈條若再出現中斷，油價則有可能重回 120 美元。”11 月交割的布倫特原油下跌 0.5%，報每桶 106.10 美元。11 月交割的 WTI 原油下跌 0.7%，報每桶 93.91 美元。

【美國新澤西州州長謝里爾敦促副州長辭職】新澤西州州長米姬·謝里爾（Mikie Sherrill）在一份宣告中表示，新澤西州副州長戴爾·考德威爾（Dale Caldwell）嚴重且屢次違反州政策，理應辭職。謝里爾表示，考德威爾必須在週五（前）辭職。謝里爾稱，一項獨立調查發現，考德威爾屢次違反州政策，且未能履行其職務職責。謝里爾在宣告中表示：“性騷擾的查實結果令人極其不安。我親眼目睹了充滿敵意的環境是如何破壞每個人取得成功的能力的。這種文化具有隱蔽的破壞性，會摧毀組織內部的信任。”

【Anthropic與Akamai達成116億美元的AI算力協議】Anthropic與Akamai Technologies簽署一項為期七年、價值116億美元的算力合同，進一步擴大資料中心佈局。根據協議，Akamai將向Anthropic提供CPU算力。近年來，隨著CPU被用於支援AI服務，資料中心對這類通用晶片的需求迎來增長。Akamai還向Anthropic發行認股權證，後者有權以每股111.33美元購買B系列股票，可轉換為770萬股Akamai普通股。這是雙方今年早些時候達成18億美元算力協議後的進一步合作。隨著客戶對Claude模型的需求近幾個月激增，Anthropic一直在大舉採購算力資源，合作物件包括Alphabet旗下的谷歌以及馬斯克旗下的SpaceX。
【國際機器人聯合會：中國正成為產業創新發展重要力量】“中國不僅是全球最大的工業機器人市場，也正成為機器人技術創新和產業發展的重要力量。”國際機器人聯合會秘書長蘇珊·比勒日前接受記者專訪時說，中國機器人產業近年來發展迅速，背後既有龐大的製造業基礎和不斷擴充套件的應用需求，也有持續增強的自主創新能力以及對人工智慧等新技術的快速應用。（新華社）

【必和必拓評估全球最大銅礦逐步復產方案】必和必拓集團表示，週三發生工人意外身亡事故後，公司正在評估各項條件，研究旗下智利埃斯康迪達銅礦專案 “逐步恢復” 採礦作業。必和必拓在一份宣告中稱，事故發生後採礦作業暫停，但礦區內部分非採礦區域仍在降負荷開展相關工作。公司將評估人員配置、作業準備情況、風險管控措施以及監管審批要求，之後再恢復生產。

【Oracle commits to pay investors if New Mexico data center lacks power】The Financial Times reports Oracle has promised investors it will continue payments even if a large New Mexico data center fails to secure power before going live. Insiders say Oracle has issued a force majeure notice to the project's developer, a unit of Blue Owl Capital, over power-supply issues. The project has faced permitting delays amid local opposition. Under contract terms, if the first phase is not ready by a 1H 2027 deadline Oracle must cover a holding-cost payment in lieu of rent for up to three years; one insider said power-delivery risk is borne by Oracle, not investors.

【紐約州起訴 Polymarket US，認定其為非法賭博機構】紐約州起訴 Polymarket US，指控其運營非法賭博業務，升級了該州針對預測市場的法律博弈。數小時後，Polymarket 發起反訴，起訴紐約州，指責該州越權監管本應由聯邦層面監管的交易平臺。紐約州總檢察長利蒂希婭・詹姆斯辦公室於週四提交州政府訴狀，請求法院下達禁令，制止 Polymarket 作為無牌照賭博機構開展經營，並要求該公司繳納罰金、沒收全部非法所得，同時向使用者作出賠償。這是該行業最新的法律衝突。這類平臺允許使用者對幾乎各類事件下注。美國商品期貨交易委員會認為預測市場屬於衍生品交易所，專屬聯邦管轄；但多個州主張本地博彩法規適用於此類平臺。美國最高法院近期已收到申請，要求對這一爭端作出裁決。州長凱茜・霍楚爾在起訴公告中表示：“Polymarket 不僅僅是明知故犯違反州法律，還將紐約民眾置於風險之中，尤其是最易產生賭博成癮問題的未成年人。”紐約州此前已起訴 Polymarket 的主要競爭對手 Kalshi 公司。

【落實“兩國方案”高階別國際會議召開】當地時間24日，在第81屆聯合國大會高階別週期間，落實“兩國方案”高階別國際會議在紐約聯合國總部舉行。此次會議由沙特、歐盟和挪威共同主辦，與會各方圍繞加沙局勢以及推動“兩國方案”從政治承諾走向實際落實展開討論。沙特外交大臣費薩爾在會後的聯合記者會上表示，無論在政治上還是領土上，加沙地帶都絕不能與約旦河西岸和東耶路撒冷分離。他還表示，加沙人道主義危機的持續，以及約旦河西岸暴力和侵權行為的增加，都在不斷削弱建立巴勒斯坦國的可行性。當前應鞏固加沙停火，確保人道主義援助立即、不受阻礙地進入加沙並推進重建。同時，應支援巴勒斯坦民族權力機構重返加沙，並推動以方停止定居點活動、吞併、強迫遷移與定居者暴力等行為。（央視新聞）

Argentina Economic Activity Falls in July — Argentina’s economic activity fell 1.4% year-over-year in July 2026, following an upwardly revised 3.1% increase in June, marking the first annual contraction since February. Seven of the 15 sectors surveyed recorded growth, led by fishing, which surged 424.5%, and mining and quarrying, which rose 8.4%. Agriculture, livestock, hunting and forestry increased 0.7%, while electricity, gas and water rose 1.9% and hotels and restaurants gained 2.5%. In contrast, wholesale and retail trade and repairs fell 5.1%, while manufacturing declined 4.6%, together subtracting 1.3 percentage points from overall growth. Construction dropped 3.3%, administration and defense fell 1.5%, and transport and communications decreased 1.5%. On a monthly basis, the EMAE fell 2.9% in seasonally adjusted terms, while the trend-cycle component increased 0.2%.The figures are from Argentina’s INDEC preliminary July 2026 report.

【高盛資產管理低配大型雲服務商 預計發債潮將持續】高盛資產管理認為，隨著大量新債湧入市場，該公司目前低配人工智慧(AI)領域借債規模最大的企業，預計超大規模雲服務商還將大舉發債。高盛資產管理多行業固定收益投資主管Lindsay Rosner週四接受媒體電視採訪時表示：“我們認為超大規模雲服務商會發行大量債券。我們整體低配這個板塊，因為知道還會有更多債券供給。”Rosner表示：“這種情況貫穿了今年全年，新發行債券正在取代現有債券。”Rosner表示，低配主要是因為預計債券供給將保持高位，而不是因為對AI前景悲觀。她說，其團隊仍然看好“AI敘事”，但也意識到更多發債可能促使市場重新定價。

US Futures Edge Lower as Bond Yields Weigh — US stock futures edged lower on Friday as surging Treasury yields continued to weigh on equities, with the Dow on track for its fourth consecutive weekly decline. Futures tied to the Dow, S&P 500 and Nasdaq 100 were each down around 0.1%. In regular trading on Thursday, the Dow slipped 0.31%, while the S&P 500 and Nasdaq Composite finished little changed. The moves came as the 10-year US Treasury yield jumped to 5.2%, its highest level since 2007, while the 30-year yield climbed to 5.5%, its highest since 2004. Oil-market volatility also pressured sentiment as investors weighed reports that the US and Iran were discussing a phased deal that could reopen the Strait of Hormuz and lift a US blockade on Iranian ports. Investors now await the University of Michigan consumer sentiment report and durable goods data due Friday, with no major earnings releases scheduled.

【股票私募倉位兩連升，滿倉佔比近七成】股票私募倉位連續第二週回升。私募排排網最新資料顯示，截至9月18日（因資訊披露合規等原因，私募淨值及倉位測算資料相對滯後），股票私募倉位指數（指有業績記錄的主觀多頭股票策略私募產品平均倉位水平）為82.73%，較前一週上漲1.43個百分點，實現連續第二週回升。從倉位分佈來看，股票私募整體維持高倉位執行。其中，67.62%的股票私募處於滿倉水平（大於80%），佔據絕對主導。百億私募倉位持續回升，截至9月18日，百億私募倉位指數為80.66%，較前一週上漲2.04個百分點，這已是百億私募連續第2周加倉。

【韓國青少年自殺率創新高，被指“社會災難”，李在明緊急發聲】對“驕傲”的韓國人而言，有一項關於“第一”的記錄被視作整個國家的沉重恥辱： 韓國的自殺率長期高居經合組織（OECD）的榜首。 9月22日，這一殘酷資料迎來更新。 據首爾新聞報道，當天，韓國國家資料處釋出的《2025年死因統計》顯示，去年韓國因自殺而身亡的人數為1.4144萬人，比前一年減少4.9%，時隔3年回落，同時多個年齡段的自殺率下降。 其中，唯獨10至19歲青少年的自殺率逆向上升。這一年齡段的自殺率為每10萬人8.6人，較前一年上升7.5%，創下有統計以來的最高值。 資料公佈後，正訪問美國的韓國總統李在明，很快在X平臺上轉發相關新聞併發文哀嘆：“令人痛心”。 “沒有什麼比生命更寶貴。改變比死亡更艱難的環境，才是政策的核心。”李在明寫道。（觀察者網）

【業內人士：預計接下來更多城市將落地執行細則，緩解因政策不確定帶來的市場觀望情緒】9月24日，“8·28”地產新政出臺近一個月，北京率先交出地方細則答卷，在封頂預售、按揭放款試點、土地款分期、現售定金制等方面均明確細化。接受記者採訪的業內人士認為，北京細則採用了“新老劃斷”與分類推進的方式，既堅定執行中央的標準，又結合北京的實際情況，給出了一些適度寬鬆，有利於開發商繼續在北京拿地投資，將為其他城市提供參考借鑑，預計接下來更多城市將落地執行細則，緩解因政策不確定帶來的市場觀望情緒。（券商中國）

【全球新能源汽車邁入全面市場化新階段 中國成為產業鏈重要基石】9月22日至24日，2026世界新能源汽車大會在海南海口舉辦。與會嘉賓認為，全球新能源汽車產業已告別政策主導的匯入期、成長期，轉向市場驅動、大範圍普及、高質量迭代的全新發展階段。中國作為重要創新輸出地，成為全球汽車產業鏈穩定執行的重要基石。 “全球新能源汽車行業已進入大範圍普及應用的全新階段。”世界新能源汽車大會主席萬鋼在大會上說，2026年上半年，全球新能源汽車銷量達1123.4萬輛，同比增長14%，市場滲透率提升至24%；全球新能源汽車累計銷量已突破9400萬輛，其中中國累計銷量超6200萬輛，穩居全球市場核心地位。（新華社）
【景順：若美債收益率持續攀升，未來12個月股市承壓的風險不容忽視】景順全球資產配置研究主管Jackson的模型顯示，若10年期美債收益率的12個月平均值升至4.72%並繼續上行，全球股市可能轉跌。目前該均值約為4.34%，距離模型門坎仍有一段距離；但他已適度減持股票，轉向政府公債，並提醒若收益率持續攀升，未來12個月股市承壓的風險不容忽視。

【高盛下調美元兌日元12個月目標價至150，市場風向轉變】高盛下調美元兌日元匯率預測，稱日本國內政策環境轉好，疊加日本資本存在迴流本土的可能性，增持日元的理由變得更加充分。策略師卡倫・賴希戈特・菲什曼（Karen Reichgott Fishman）最新預測：美元兌日元三個月目標158，六個月目標155，十二個月目標150；此前預測分別為162、163、165。她在研報中寫道：“綜合上述變化，做多日元的吸引力上升，尤其適合對沖衰退擔憂來襲的風險。”高盛同時認為，日本進一步實施外匯干預的潛在威脅，將限制美元兌日元的上行空間。短期來看，高盛維持謹慎的戰術立場，偏好做空歐元兌日元。
高盛將美元兌日元未來12個月的預期匯率下調至150。

He dismissed allegations of genocide in Gaza as "the biggest lie of the century," accused Qatar and Turkey of spreading falsehoods on social media, and accused New York City mayor Mamdani of antisemitism.

【內塔尼亞胡稱打伊朗是最容易決定】當地時間9月24日下午，北京時間今天（9月25日）凌晨，以色列總理內塔尼亞胡在第81屆聯大一般性辯論發表講話，為以色列的所謂“七線戰爭”辯護，稱對伊朗發動襲擊是他“作出過的最容易的決定之一”，是為了“自衛及保護其他國家”。他還辯稱有關以色列在加沙實施種族滅絕的指控是“本世紀最大的謊言”，指責卡達、土耳其等國在社交媒體上“散佈關於以色列的謊言”，同時指責紐約市長馬姆達尼反猶。 內塔尼亞胡在發言過程中還接連拿出尋呼機和“星鏈”終端裝置，承認以色列實施了2024年9月針對黎巴嫩真主黨的“尋呼機爆炸襲擊”，並煽動伊朗民眾利用偷運入境的“星鏈”終端獲取資訊，推翻現政權。
【馬克龍稱將派兵保護沙特延布石油設施 】法國總統馬克龍24日說，法國將派兵保護沙烏地阿拉伯西海岸延布港的石油設施免受葉門胡塞武裝襲擊，以穩定石油供給、控制油價上漲。 馬克龍在接受兩家法國電視臺聯合採訪時說，法國已與沙特完成相關討論，法方將派出士兵並部署雷達、防禦系統等軍事力量，同時視局勢變化調動駐紮在中東地區的空軍力量。他強調，此舉是為了保護延布的石油設施，而不是參與相關衝突。

El Salvador Trade Gap Widens in August — El Salvador’s trade deficit widened to $1.15 billion in August 2026 from $875.4 million a year earlier, as imports rose while exports declined. Imports increased 17.5% year-on-year to $1.64 billion, compared with $1.40 billion in August 2025, while exports fell 6% to $492.6 million from $523.8 million. Import growth was broad-based, led by consumer goods, which rose about 23%, and intermediate goods, up nearly 19%, while capital-goods imports increased about 5%. Exports were weighed by non-maquila shipments, which fell about 8%, partly offset by a roughly 8% increase in maquila exports. Coffee exports were about $12 million in August, little changed from a year earlier, while sugar exports fell to about $8.5 million from $14.7 million.

【Anthropic擬效仿Palantir模式，讓七位聯合創始人掌握投票權，為上市鋪路】據知情人士透露，Anthropic 正提請股東批准一套新公司架構，授予執行長達里奧・阿莫代伊及其餘六位聯合創始人特殊類別股份，使其在多數公司事務上擁有集體投票控制權。其中一位訊息人士稱，這套效仿帕蘭提爾（Palantir）創始人控股模式的新安排，只要七位聯合創始人中有三人持有公司最低限額股份，全體創始人合計便可掌握 50.1% 的投票權。這將大幅改變 Anthropic 本就特殊的治理架構，在公司上市後抵禦外部股東壓力，鞏固持股比例相對不高的創始團隊的影響力。創始人控制權存在一項重要例外：Anthropic 董事會席位共 7 席，目前尚有 1 席空缺，董事會多數席位的任命權歸屬於公司長期利益信託。該信託成員並非公司股東，其中包含前美聯儲主席本・伯南克，負責就安全與社會議題向公司提供建議。在擬議的新架構下，該信託將繼續保有這項權力。創始人目前可任命兩名董事。但在新公司架構下，這一名額將增至三名。公司正提請股東在未來數日內批准該擬議方案。

Brent Halts Rally on Talks of a Phased Deal — Brent crude steadied near $106 per barrel on Friday, pausing its recent rally amid reports that the US and Iran were considering a phased deal that could reopen the Strait of Hormuz and lift a US blockade on Iranian ports. Efforts to reach a breakthrough were reportedly underway on the sidelines of the UN General Assembly, with Qatari officials mediating the talks. Iran has maintained that it must retain control over Hormuz and would not accept a deal unless the US eases military pressure and removes its blockade. Meanwhile, a White House official said President Donald Trump remained open to talks with Iran but stressed that the US had little need to negotiate given its strong position following the sanctions campaign and blockade. Elsewhere, tensions in the Middle East escalated after Iran-aligned Houthi militants in Yemen launched missiles toward Saudi cities, including Yanbu and Taif. Brent prices are on track to gain more than 2% for the week.

【巴總理會見伊朗總統 強調落實美伊諒解備忘錄 】巴基斯坦總理辦公室24日發表宣告說，巴總理夏巴茲當天在美國紐約舉行的第81屆聯合國大會期間會見伊朗總統佩澤希齊揚，強調落實美伊諒解備忘錄，重申巴方將繼續發揮建設性作用，支援地區和平與穩定。 宣告說，雙方就不斷變化的地區局勢交換意見。夏巴茲對持續不斷的地區衝突深表關切，呼籲有關各方保持克制、為緊張局勢降溫並持續開展外交接觸，以實現該地區的持久和平與穩定。他強調，伊斯蘭堡諒解備忘錄應當得到落實。 宣告說，佩澤希齊揚讚賞巴方為地區和平與安全所作的努力，重申伊方願進一步深化雙方全方位合作。

【Reuters survey: RBA likely to lift cash rate to 4.60% next week; tightening seen near end】In a Reuters survey of 34 economists conducted Sep 17-24, 33 forecast the Reserve Bank of Australia will raise the cash rate by 25bps to 4.60% at its Sep 29 meeting, the highest since late 2011. It would be the fourth hike this year, bringing cumulative tightening to 100bps. Persistent inflation and resilient growth were cited as reasons for further tightening, but most respondents view September as likely the final hike in this cycle; a minority expect rates to reach 4.85% by year-end. The poll marks a notable shift from a month earlier, when nearly all economists expected the RBA to hold and the median peak was 4.35%.

【美伊據稱磋商分階段協議，以期重開霍爾木茲海峽】據知情人士透露，美國與伊朗談判代表正在磋商一項分階段協議，內容包括伊朗重開霍爾木茲海峽，美國解除對伊朗港口的封鎖。這位不願具名的訊息人士稱，兩國近幾個月均拒絕簽署類似協議，週四在聯合國大會期間推動談判尋求突破。訊息人士補充說，卡達官員擔任此次談判的斡旋方。這份分步協議的模式和美伊 6 月中旬達成的諒解備忘錄相近，該備忘錄曾促成脆弱停火，但停火僅維持數週便宣告破裂。一名白宮官員表示，唐納德・特朗普總統仍願意與伊朗對話，但強調美國無需談判；持續加碼的制裁以及正在實施的海上封鎖已重創伊朗經濟，美國處於有利地位。自戰爭爆發以來，美伊斷斷續續的談判已多次破裂，分歧主要集中在霍爾木茲海峽問題，以及伊朗何時能夠獲取被美國凍結的數十億美元資金。正在紐約出席聯合國峰會的伊朗總統馬蘇德・佩澤希齊揚在演講中強調，只要制裁與美國海上封鎖仍未解除，伊朗就不會允許霍爾木茲海峽自由通航。
【全球債券指數收益率自2007年以來首次升至4%】受油價上漲加劇通脹擔憂影響，主要國債市場平均收益率升至4%，為2007年以來首次。彭博國債指數收益率上漲5個基點，報4.04%。

【受關稅退款利好提振，Costco季度利潤超預期】在計入與關稅退款相關的收益後，Costco Wholesale Corp.（好市多）的季度利潤超過了華爾街的預期。這家大型零售商在截至8月30日的季度中，剔除部分專案後的每股收益（EPS）為6.75美元，高於彭博社彙總的分析師平均預期。其中，關稅退款為每股收益貢獻了15美分。
【特斯拉將在內華達州新工廠落成典禮上正式推出Semi電動卡車】特斯拉將於當地時間週四晚在內華達州斯帕克斯市的新工廠落成典禮上推出其Semi卡車。這家電動汽車製造商在其官網和社交媒體上表示，距離執行長埃隆·馬斯克首次揭曉這款電動重型卡車已近九年。Semi卡車專為長途貨運設計，續航里程可達500英里，於2017年首次亮相，原計劃於2019年投產。

【特斯拉內華達州工廠投產，重型Semi卡車產量即將提升】特斯拉將在內華達州斯帕克斯市正式啟用首座量產重型電動卡車Semi的工廠，執行長埃隆・馬斯克藉此進軍重型卡車領域。特斯拉於2017年首次釋出Semi卡車，並在2022年向包括核心客戶百事公司在內的首批客戶小批次交付。週四的剪彩儀式將進行線上直播，直播時間為美國東部時間晚9點，即當地時間下午6點。該工廠投產之際，特斯拉的電動汽車核心業務在全球面臨愈發激烈的競爭；同時柴油價格高企，為商用卡車領域轉向電動化帶來潛在機遇。

UK Consumer Confidence Hits More Than 2-Year High — The UK GfK Consumer Confidence Index rose to -13 in September 2026 from -14 in the previous month, unexpectedly reaching its highest level since August 2024 as households became more optimistic about their personal finances and the economic outlook. The reading came above the Reuters poll forecast of -16, adding to recent signs of resilience in the UK economy. Confidence in the economic outlook climbed to its highest level since August 2024, while the mood around personal finances reached an eight-month high. Separate YouGov/Cebr and LSEG/Ipsos surveys also recorded their strongest readings since February. However, GfK warned that confidence remains firmly in negative territory, while rising inflation, energy and fuel prices could weigh on households and cause sentiment to falter in the months ahead.

【GfK：英國消費者信心的提振勢頭正在減弱】英國消費者信心在9月僅微幅上升，這表明由安迪·伯納姆（Andy Burnham）出任首相所引發的樂觀情緒，正隨著人們對生活成本擔憂的加劇而開始消退。捷孚凱（GfK）表示，其消費者信心指數僅上升了1個百分點至-13，而在前兩個月該指數曾大幅飆升了9個百分點。消費者同時表示，他們購買大件商品的意願有所下降。捷孚凱消費者洞察總監尼爾·貝拉米（Neil Bellamy）在接受電話採訪時表示：“這是一個臨界點。人們正在展望未來，並對能源價格的走勢感到擔憂。”伯納姆於7月接替基爾·斯塔默（Keir Starmer）出任首相，並立即宣佈了一系列旨在幫助民眾應對生活成本危機的措施。然而，這種被稱為“伯納姆反彈”的樂觀情緒似乎正在耗盡動力，因為消費者正在承受伊朗戰爭帶來的全面衝擊。燃料和能源成本的不斷上漲正在推高通脹，並增加了英國央行加息的壓力。與此同時，外界越來越猜測，財政大臣約翰·希利（John Healey）將在下個月的預算案中提高稅收，以彌補近期債券市場動盪對公共財政造成的損害。彭博經濟研究的一項分析發現，隨著1月份價格上限的重新調整，家庭能源賬單可能會再上漲25%——這一漲幅將推動2027年的消費者物價指數（CPI）通脹率升至4%以上。

Traders also anticipated the release of China’s PMI data, New Zealand’s top trading partner, as well as the US PCE Index and jobs data due next week, which could provide clues about the Fed’s monetary policy decision at its upcoming meeting. Among the early losers were Meridian Energy (-1.5%), Westpac Banking Corp. (-1.2%), Ryman Healthcare (-0.8%), FC Investment (-0.7%), and Infratil (-0.5%). For the week, the index rose 0.4%, which would mark its second straight weekly gain.

【Meta market cap nears $2 trillion as Muse-fueled rally posts best month since 2013】Meta Platforms (META.O) shares rose 36% in September, their strongest monthly gain since July 2013, taking market value close to $2 trillion. The rally followed the launch of personal AI assistant Muse, which investors see as a new growth avenue and a partial answer to concerns over returns on large AI investments. Shares had been pressured earlier this year by heavy AI spending, legal risks to its social media business and soft revenue expectations, leaving them about 18% below the start of the year; since an August low the stock is up roughly 43%. Meta is expanding its AI product slate, including a portable Muse device and a camera-less smart glasses variant, and forecasts capex near $140 billion in 2026, rising to $197 billion in 2027 and $215 billion in 2028. Analysts currently project 2026 revenue of $254 billion (up 26% YoY) and net income of $80.6 billion (up 33% YoY).

【對沖基金Situational Awareness今年成為高盛最大客戶】對沖基金Situational Awareness今年成為高盛規模最大的主經紀商客戶。這家機構此前名不見經傳，卻在遭遇數百億美元鉅額虧損之後，依然擁有如此驚人的業務體量，這件事十分值得關注。 知情人士透露，今年高盛從向Situational Awareness提供借貸服務中賺取了超2億美元手續費，這也是高盛面向對沖基金的主經紀業務板塊從單一客戶身上取得的最高收入。 訊息人士補充稱，由Leopold Aschenbrenner管理的該基金，依靠多筆高收益AI押注一戰成名，今年同樣也是高盛交易部門最重要的客戶之一。 Situational Awareness成立才不到兩年，就能和城堡投資（Citadel）、千禧管理（Millennium）這類老牌頂級對沖基金並列，成為高盛這樣頭部投行的核心大客戶，這在華爾街幾乎聞所未聞。

【Bezos has put $30 bln into Blue Origin; company valued at $140 bln】Jeff Bezos has invested about $30 bln in Blue Origin since founding the company in 2000 to develop rockets, satellite communications and other space businesses. Documents reviewed by the Wall Street Journal show Blue Origin is running its first external funding round, has raised roughly $10 bln and is valued at about $140 bln. The company employs ~15,000 and aims to ramp commercial revenue to ~$800 mln in 2025, ~$1.4 bln in 2026 and more than $30 bln by 2030. Management identifies rocket launches, satellite communications and AI-enabled satellite services as the main growth drivers, and cites the heavy reusable New Glenn rocket as central to narrowing the gap with SpaceX.

Paraguay Producer Prices Extend Decline — Paraguay’s Producer Price Index fell 1.7% year over year in August 2025, following a 1.5% decline in July and marking its seventh consecutive annual decrease. By product grouping, both domestic and imported products made negative contributions to the overall result. The decline was mainly driven by negative contributions from domestic agriculture and horticultural products, as well as imported metallic products, machinery and equipment, and food, beverages and tobacco, textiles, and leather products. Other sections, particularly domestic non-metallic transportable goods and other manufactured products, helped mitigate the decline. The PPI was unchanged on a monthly basis, while the cumulative change in the first eight months of the year stood at -0.7%.

Banxico Holds Key Rate at 6.50% in September — Mexico’s central bank left its benchmark interest rate unchanged at 6.50% at its September meeting, in line with market expectations. The governing board said it assessed the inflation outlook considering exchange-rate developments, differences in the economic cycles of Mexico and the US, the absence of demand pressures in Mexico, and the degree of monetary restriction in place. The headline inflation forecast for the third quarter of 2026 was revised downward due to lower-than-expected non-core inflation, while the core inflation forecast was revised slightly upward. The balance of risks around the inflation outlook remains tilted to the upside. Changes in US economic policy and prolonged geopolitical conflicts continue to add uncertainty. Meanwhile, the Mexican economy is estimated to have moderated in the third quarter, with slack conditions expected throughout the forecast horizon and downside risks to economic activity persisting.

Egypt Holds Rate for Sixth Straight Meeting — The Central Bank of Egypt kept its key interest rate unchanged at 19% at its September 2026 meeting, in line with market expectations amid still-high inflation and regional and energy shocks. This marked the sixth consecutive meeting with rates on hold. The CBE said the global outlook remains uncertain due to geopolitical tensions, tighter financial conditions, and renewed supply chain disruptions. Domestic economic activity continued to moderate due to regional tensions, while the projected output gap suggests limited demand-side inflationary pressures in the short term. Annual headline inflation eased marginally, while core inflation remained relatively stable. The CBE revised its inflation forecast downward, but said risks remain tilted to the upside amid renewed regional hostilities. It added that the current degree of policy restrictiveness should help buffer these risks and preserve the projected disinflation path.

The gap between men and women persisted, with female unemployment at 8.8%, compared with 5.7% for men. Unemployment varied significantly by age, reaching 23.4% among young people aged 14 to 24, the group facing the greatest difficulties entering the labor market. US Stocks Trim Losses — US stocks pared losses on Thursday after the potential for diplomatic breakthroughs between the US and Iran softened the surge in energy prices. The S&P 500, Dow, and Nasdaq 100 traded near the flatline. Reports suggested that US and Iranian negotiators were closer to agreeing on restoring tanker flows through the Strait of Hormuz, easing fuel prices and yields on shorter-dated maturities. AI hyperscalers rebounded following their losses earlier this week, with Alphabet adding 1.5%. Meanwhile, Meta jumped 4%, extending its rally to 16% this week following positive feedback on its AI agent software and gadget releases. However, the risk of tight financial conditions continued to pressure chipmakers due to heavy debt issuance for AI infrastructure, with Nvidia, Intel, Marvell, and Micron trading down by up to 3%. Separately, Oracle fell 4.5% after declaring force majeure on setbacks to the development of a data center in New Mexico.

【巴基斯坦總理會見伊朗總統 強調推動地區局勢降溫】當地時間24日，巴基斯坦總理辦公室發表通告稱，巴基斯坦總理夏巴茲在美國紐約出席第81屆聯合國大會期間與伊朗總統佩澤希齊揚舉行會見。會見中，雙方重申巴基斯坦和伊朗之間長期友好關係，並表示將進一步加強各領域雙邊合作。雙方還就地區局勢交換意見。夏巴茲表示，巴方對持續的地區衝突深表關切，強調應保持克制、推動局勢降級，並持續開展外交接觸，以實現地區持久和平與穩定。他同時強調落實《伊斯蘭堡諒解備忘錄》的重要性，並表示巴基斯坦願繼續為推動地區和平與穩定發揮建設性作用。佩澤希齊揚表示，伊朗讚賞巴基斯坦為推動地區和平與安全所開展的外交努力，並希望進一步深化兩國在多個領域的合作。雙方同意加強定期磋商和協調，共同推動地區和平、安全與繁榮。（央視）

【OpenAI、Anthropic被要求在完成白宮測試之前不能給英國分享新模型】據知情人士和一位獲准匿名描述該請求的美國政府高階官員透露，白宮已要求 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 在美國政府完成測試之前，不要與英國政府的測試機構分享其最新的人工智慧模型。這項來自美國國家網路總監辦公室的請求，使相關企業陷入了兩難境地：他們要麼拒絕向英國人工智慧安全研究所提供模型——該機構是全球資源最豐富的政府測試機構之一，此前曾享有優先獲取新模型的特權；要麼就得冒著惹惱特朗普政府白宮的風險。這位政府高階官員表示，白宮希望美國能在模型分享給美國盟友之前，先對其進行審查，並採取相關措施以確保美國系統的安全。

Brent Crude Eases from Surge — Brent oil prices were near $105 per barrel on Thursday, trimming a surge that peaked at $97 amid signs that the US and Iran could be working to re-establish exports from the Persian Gulf. Reports suggested that US and Iranian negotiators were exploring a deal that would lift naval blockades against tankers crossing the Strait of Hormuz and ease US sanctions on the Iranian economy. Strikes on commercial vessels earlier this month had brought oil exports out of GCC countries to a near standstill. The supply disruption was compounded by attacks on the East-West pipeline in Saudi Arabia, which had been diverting 7 million bpd of crude to Red Sea ports. The prolonged halt of tanker flows from the region forced major OPEC members to cut oil production, with Saudi output recently dropping to its lowest level since 1990. Lower stocks from China risked buying from the world's top importer, while the US Strategic Petroleum Reserve (SPR) stands at a near-record low.

Lumber Falls Near Nine-Month Low — Lumber futures fell to around $530 per thousand board feet, remaining near their lowest level in nine months, as rising borrowing costs weigh on housing demand. Growing concerns over inflationary pressures have fueled a broader selloff in global government debt markets, pushing yields to their highest level in nearly two decades. As a result, mortgage rates climbed above 7%, a level last seen in January 2025, further weighing on prospective homebuyers. Although lacking any particular economic significance, economists refer to the threshold as a psychological ceiling. Meanwhile, lumber-intensive single-family housing starts increased 7.6% in August. Providing an offsetting pressure, Ottawa had announced counter-tariffs of 25% on US lumber and 50% on plywood following US tariffs on several lumber-related goods. US forestry groups have long accused Canada of distorting the market, as Canadian forestland is largely publicly owned, allowing its lumber to be sold at lower prices.

European Stocks Fall Further — European stocks closed lower on Thursday as soaring energy prices lifted benchmark rates. The Euro STOXX 50 fell 0.4% to 6,275, and the STOXX Europe 600 fell 0.5% to 637. Fuel and natural gas prices surged amid signs that the naval blockade in the Persian Gulf could be prolonged, in addition to signals from the US presidential administration that diesel exports could be banned. Sovereign yields extended their surge this week, weighing on the corporate sector. Infineon sank 4.2% and Siemens Energy dropped 1.7%, tracking the negative AI trade in North America. On top of that, banks were also mostly lower, with UniCredit and Deutsche Bank losing 1.6% and 2.3%, respectively. Meanwhile, Dior surged 16% after the Arnault family group announced a €469-per-share cash offer. Outside the eurozone, the SNB held rates as expected and pushed back against franc intervention, steadying Swiss banks. On the other hand, the Riksbank delivered a hawkish hold, and Norges Bank lifted its policy rate.

Brent Crude Rises Above $107 — Brent crude extended gains to over $107 a barrel on Thursday, as escalating tensions in the Middle East heightened concerns over regional energy supplies. Yemen’s Houthi group said it had attacked Saudi military sites in Jazan, while Saudi Arabia reported intercepting missiles launched toward the Red Sea port of Yanbu. Traders are closely monitoring Saudi crude shipments amid the renewed attacks. Oil prices had already been rising after Iran threatened to broaden the conflict, further reducing optimism over a potential agreement to reopen the strategically important Strait of Hormuz. A senior Iranian military official said Tehran could expand the conflict to the Indian Ocean if the US or Israel launches another attack, according to Iran’s Fars news agency. The comments weakened hopes for a diplomatic resolution to the nearly seven-month conflict. Tehran has also maintained that it will restrict freedom of navigation through Hormuz while US sanctions and a blockade remain in place.

Two people familiar with the talks said negotiators have agreed language aimed at protecting consumers from power-price increases tied to data-center construction.

【MPs to review whether Bank of England's remit is 'fit for purpose'】Parliament's cross-party Treasury Committee said on Tuesday it has opened a review to assess whether the Bank of England's remit remains fit for purpose and whether monetary policy independence still operates effectively. The probe will examine the remit 30 years after the Bank was granted operational independence to set interest rates to meet the inflation target. The review comes as the Bank faces scrutiny after inflation rose higher and persisted longer than in other advanced economies following the Russia-Ukraine war, and after it was forced to defend its handling of bond sales during QT.

Kansas Fed Manufacturing Activity Rises in September — The Kansas City Fed’s Manufacturing Production Index rose to 20 in September 2026, its highest reading since April 2022, up from 17 in the previous month. Both durable and nondurable manufacturing activity increased, driven primarily by plastics and rubber products and furniture-related products. Monthly activity was broadly stronger, with shipments increasing to 21 from 17, while the volume of new orders rose to 24 from 16, both a multi-month high. Employment was flat for a second consecutive month. Price pressures also intensified, particularly for raw materials. Compared with a year earlier, the manufacturing production index eased slightly to 19, while shipments increased to 23 from 13 and the volume of new orders fell to 22 from 23. Price pressures also increased further, while employment declined to -3 from 5. Over the next six months, activity is expected to remain in expansionary territory, although the index edged down to 9 from 20.

【PepsiCo to raise prices on some snacks and drinks after cuts failed to lift volumes】PepsiCo will raise prices on select chips, sodas and dips after months of earlier cuts failed to boost volumes, people familiar with the matter said. The increases will hit grocery-pack potato chips, including Doritos and Ruffles, and other brands such as SunChips, and are expected to take effect late this year or in early 2027. A company spokesman said the hikes will be in the low-to-mid single-digit pct range, broadly in line with inflation, and that new prices will remain below pre-cut levels; PepsiCo said it is still trying to keep prices as low as sustainably possible to preserve affordability.

US Natgas Prices Rise to 11-Week High — US natural gas prices rose to $3.07 per million British thermal units, their highest level since July 8, after an EIA report showed a storage build broadly in line with expectations. Energy firms added 53 billion cubic feet to inventories in the week ended September 18, below the 77 bcf increase recorded a year earlier and the five-year average of 76 bcf, as hot weather boosted cooling demand. Inventories stood 2.9% above normal, down from 3.7% the previous week. US Lower 48 production was also on track to fall to an 11-week low of 108.4 bcfd on Thursday, mainly due to declines in Louisiana and West Virginia. Weather forecasts point to mostly normal conditions through October 9. Meanwhile, average gas flows to the nine major US LNG export plants reached 17.8 bcfd in September, up from 17.2 bcfd in August, despite the planned shutdown of Berkshire Hathaway Energy’s 0.8-bcfd Cove Point facility for annual maintenance.

【歐洲央行管委Radev：必須給之前的加息行動足夠的時間發揮作用】歐洲央行管理委員會委員Dimitar Radev表示，在判斷此前加息是否正在有效遏制通脹之前，決策者不應急於採取進一步行動。這位保加利亞央行行長週四在MNI Connect視訊會議上發表講話時強調，本月加息並不意味著歐洲央行已經“踏上預先設定的政策路徑”。“耐心仍然很重要，但警惕性的重要程度應該略高一些，”Radev表示。“這並不是呼籲自動收緊政策，而是意味著我們應給此前的政策決定留出發揮作用的時間，同時如果證據顯示通脹具有更強的持續性，也要做好採取應對措施的準備。”上述言論顯示，相比於一些決策者提出的最早在10月29日再次行動，Radev可能更傾向於等到歐洲央行12月會議時再決定是否進一步加息。屆時歐洲央行將公佈季度經濟預測，從而為官員做出決策提供更多資訊。Radev表示，歐洲央行目前尚無法完全確定，中東戰爭引發的能源成本飆升究竟會侷限在能源領域，還是會向經濟其他領域擴散。不過他指出，目前尚未出現“廣泛的第二輪效應”。“通脹仍高於我們的目標，而能源衝擊的持續時間可能比最初預期更長，”Radev說。“與此同時，歐元區經濟展現出的韌性也強於許多人此前的預期。當前的任務，是判斷這輪衝擊是否會繼續大體侷限於能源領域，還是會變得更加持久並廣泛擴散。”

Dollar Strengthens Further — The dollar index extended its gains for a fourth consecutive session, rising to 101.2 on Thursday, its longest winning streak since May and keeping it near July highs. The dollar has been supported by expectations of further Fed tightening. Oil prices also moved higher amid elevated tensions between the US and Iran, while talks on the sidelines of the UN General Assembly have made little progress toward ending the conflict. Higher energy prices are likely to add further pressure on inflation, particularly as US diesel prices hit a new record high. Against this backdrop, traders have increased their bets on further Fed tightening this year. Markets are now pricing in nearly a 64% chance of another 25 bps rate hike in October. Recent comments from several Fed officials have also been perceived as hawkish. Meanwhile, the dollar strengthened against the Swiss franc after the Swiss National Bank left interest rates unchanged at 0%. The Japanese yen also weakened to three-week lows.

One industry source said crude is being transported to Red Sea coastal refineries but not reloaded onto tankers; two other sources confirmed tanker loading remains halted.

TSX Edges Lower on Higher Bond Yields — The S&P/TSX Composite Index inched lower to below 36,000 on Thursday as a sharp rise in global government bond yields weighed on stock markets. Canada’s 10-year government bond yield neared a three-year high as energy-driven inflation concerns persisted and US Treasury yields soared to multi-decade highs. Crude oil rose amid heightened Middle East tensions, while strong economic data released on Wednesday drove US yields higher, intensifying the global move amid rising expectations of another Fed hike this year. Financial stocks traded mostly near flat. Gold prices fell, pressuring mining stocks, with Agnico Eagle, Barrick, and WPM all shedding more than 1%. Kinross plunged nearly 10% after lowering its production outlook for 2026 and 2027. Meanwhile, energy shares gained on higher oil prices. Retailers rose as estimates showed retail sales likely rebounded in August, posting their strongest gain since January. Elsewhere, BlackBerry shed over 1% despite reporting strong 2Q26 results.

US New Home Sales Rise to YTD High — Sales of new single-family homes in the US jumped 6.4% from the previous month to a seasonally adjusted annualized rate of 684,000 in August 2026. It was the highest level of sales since the start of the year, beating market expectations of 620,000, even though hawkish Federal Reserve expectations lifted mortgage rates during the period. Sales surged in the Midwest (84.9% to 98,000) and edged higher in the South (6.9% to 451,000), which was enough to offset declines in the Northeast (-36.1% to 23,000) and the West (-15.2% to 112,000). The outstanding supply of new houses was unchanged at 483,000, equivalent to 8.5 months of supply at the current sales pace. Meanwhile, the median sales price inched higher to $393,700.

Ibovespa Near Flat Amid Macroeconomic Concerns — The Ibovespa hovered near the flatline at around 186,000 on Thursday following the release of the BCB’s monetary policy report. The BCB said the recent oil price shock has not yet generated significant inflationary pass-through through indirect effects on the Brazilian economy, despite direct impacts on prices. The central bank also cut its 2026 GDP growth forecast to 1.8% from 2.0% in June. Meanwhile, the federal government decided to reduce the 2026 budget spending block by R$1.9 billion, bringing the total amount blocked to R$16.1 billion, amid concerns over elevated government spending. Financials posted losses, with Bradesco and BB down about 0.5% each, while B3 shed nearly 1%. Utilities also fell, with Axia down 0.5%. Other notable laggards included WEG (-2%) and Embraer (-1%). In contrast, Petrobras rose more than 0.5% as oil prices climbed on Middle East tensions. Likewise, Vale added nearly 0.5% amid iron ore supply concerns in Brazil.

The capesize index, which typically transports 150,000-ton cargoes, including iron ore and coal, increased by 1.3% to 5,939 points; and the panamax index, which usually carries 60,000 to 70,000 tons of coal or grain, advanced 2.1% to 2,382 points. Among smaller vessels, the supramax index went up by 0.2% to 1,782 points.

【摩根士丹利預計明年全球雲端支出破萬億美元，儲存超一半】摩根士丹利執行董事顏志天9月23日在深圳舉行的2026年全球儲存器行業創新峰會（GMIF2026）上演講時表示，預計2027年全球雲服務商（又稱“雲端”）資本支出將達1.2萬億美元，其中超過一半用於儲存。他預測有些雲服務商明年的資本支出將超過其息稅及攤銷前利潤，由於儲存貴且頻寬不足，因此需要從先進封裝等方面加快創新。 摩根士丹利研報顯示，今年全球雲端資本支出可能超9000億美元，其中儲存（未含HBM（高頻寬記憶體））佔比48%；明年全球雲端資本支出可能達1.2萬億美元，其中儲存佔比增至53%；後年隨著儲存、GPU需求增長，全球雲端資本支出將達1.6萬億美元。 “現在很火的話題是，HBM明年的需求到底是多少。”顏志天說，初步估計明年HBM的消費量大約是440億美元，比去年和今年顯著增長，但目前看供應還是非常吃緊。（第一財經）

US Stocks Extend Decline — US stocks fell further on Thursday as higher Treasury yields reflected an increasingly adverse macroeconomic backdrop. The S&P 500 fell 0.5%, while those for the Nasdaq 100 dropped almost 1% and those for the Dow eased 0.3%. Treasury notes and bonds of all maturities held their plunge from the previous session as PMI data showed an accelerating economy and soaring prices, raising the outlook for interest rates by the Fed. This coincided with dimmed expectations of diplomatic breakthroughs between Iran, the US, and GCC countries, prolonging the blockade on oil exports from the region. The risk of tight financial conditions continued to pressure AI hyperscalers and chip producers as the sector was due to extend its record-setting debt issuance momentum, with Nvidia, Marvell, Intel, Amazon, and Alphabet dropping between 1% and 3%. Meanwhile, Meta dropped 2% to trim this week's rally as markets assessed the prospects of returns on its new AI agent tools.

【日本10年期國債收益率再創新高】日本國債市場24日各期限國債收益率大幅上升。其中，作為長期利率指標的新發10年期國債收益率升至3.075%，創1996年8月以來新高。資料顯示，新發2年期日本國債收益率較前一交易日上升6個基點至1.900%，創1995年4月以來新高；新發5年期日本國債收益率上升10.5個基點至2.380%，創歷史新高；新發20年期日本國債收益率上升10.5個基點至3.920%。債券期貨市場上，因價格短時間內劇烈波動，大阪交易所一度啟動“動態熔斷機制”，暫時停止長期國債期貨交易，抑制市場異常波動。一些市場分析人士認為，美聯儲進一步加息預期升溫，推動美國長期利率上行，並傳導至日本債券市場。（新華社）

【美國首次申請失業救濟人數降至7月以來最低 仍處於歷史低點附近】上週美國首次申領失業救濟人數降至7月以來的最低水平，表明在總體穩定的勞動力市場中，裁員仍然很少見。美國勞工部週四公佈的資料顯示，在截至9月19日當週，首次申領失業救濟人數小幅減少1,000人，降至19.7萬人。這也是自1969年以來的最低水平之一。截至9月12日當週，持續申請失業救濟人數基本持平於172萬人，仍徘徊在接近2023年以來最低水平的位置。該資料可作為領取失業救濟人數的參考指標。過去幾個月，首次申請失業救濟人數一直處於歷史低位附近，企業對裁員仍較為謹慎。與此同時，招聘活動表現不均，令那些感覺被困在現有工作崗位、或仍處於勞動力市場之外的美國人面臨有限的就業機會。

【沙特7月石油出口額降至新低】沙烏地阿拉伯統計總局24日釋出的資料顯示，沙特7月石油出口額和出口總額雙雙繼續下降，分別降至2025年5月和2021年6月以來的最低水平。俄羅斯新聞社引用該資料包道，沙特7月石油出口額為598.88億里亞爾（約合159億美元），比去年同期下降12.8%，為2025年5月以來最低。沙特7月商品出口總額為843.79億里亞爾（224億美元），同比下降17.2%，為2021年6月以來最低。石油出口在沙特出口總額中的佔比從6月的71.7%降至7月的71%。沙特7月進口額也下降至700.15億里亞爾（186億美元），同比降幅達15.4%。業內人士分析說，沙特石油出口額下降主要由美伊軍事衝突導致。自美國和以色列2月底對伊朗發動軍事打擊以來，霍爾木茲海峽通航持續受阻，嚴重影響沙特原油外運。在此情況下，沙特加大“東油西送”，將其東部油田的原油透過管道輸送至西海岸延布港，從連線紅海與亞丁灣的曼德海峽出口。不過，7月20日葉門胡塞武裝宣佈對沙特實施“海上封鎖”，沙特從紅海出口原油的航線也受到威脅。（央視新聞）

【摩根大通Peters看好股票 收益率上升考驗企業盈利】摩根大通的Grace Peters表示，儘管債券收益率上升對盈利增長提出了更高要求，股市仍可繼續上漲。Peters列舉了推動債券收益率走高的幾個因素：強勁的經濟增長資料、為人工智慧基礎設施融資而進入市場的債券供應，以及油價升至每桶100美元以上引發的通脹擔憂。她表示，固定收益資產在投資組合中仍有一席之地，但需要有所選擇；相比之下，她更青睞股票，因為她預計市場將迎來一個範圍不斷擴大的盈利“超級週期”。“我們的信心確實在股票上，我們認為股票將成為投資組合的增長引擎，”她在接受彭博電視採訪時表示。Peters表示，面對收益率上升，股市並未掉以輕心。她指出，10年期美國國債收益率本月已累計變動約40個基點。“這還沒有達到兩個標準差的變動幅度，而達到那種程度才可能真正擾動股市。但股市顯然會對此有所反應，而且我認為，市場已經在相當程度上消化了這一因素，”她說。

【谷歌將AI資料中心競賽推向太空：下週四將把一顆實驗衛星送入軌道】下週四，谷歌將把一顆實驗衛星送入軌道。這顆衛星具備足夠算力，可從太空應答簡單的人工智慧查詢請求。這項工作隸屬於谷歌一項雄心勃勃的專案——捕日者計劃（Project Suncatcher）。該專案旨在把人工智慧資料中心部署至太空，利用太陽能為其供電。10月1日，這顆出自舊金山實驗室、谷歌命名為MVP的衛星，將成為科技巨頭邁出的第一步。衛星將在加州聖巴巴拉附近的范登堡太空軍基地，搭載SpaceX獵鷹9號火箭發射入軌。

Belgium Business Pessimism Eases — Belgium’s business confidence indicator increased by 1.1 point to -12.1 in September 2026, from -13.2 in August, contrasting with market expectations of a further decline to -13.5. Sentiment improved in manufacturing (-12.2 vs -17.8), reflecting greater optimism in building materials and flat glass (-24.9 vs -45), the manufacture of ferrous and non-ferrous basic metals (-10.9 vs -34.9), and capital goods (-7.7 vs -14.6). Confidence also improved in roofing activities (10.7 vs 9.9). In contrast, pessimism deepened in construction-related services, including structural building work (-11.8 vs -7.7), construction installation (-8.3 vs -1.9), and building completion and finishing (-20 vs -10.4), as well as business-related services (-13.4 vs -1.4) and trade (-8.6 vs -5.6).
